title: Kompensatorische Assistenz (m/w/d)* (Sozialassistent/in)
description:
Wir sind Mehr als Eins, ein deutschlandweit agierender Assistenzdienst für Menschen mit komplexer Lebensgeschichte.

Für unsere Klientin suchen wir zwei zuverlässige und empathische Assistenzen, die im Alltag unterstützen und einen stabilen, respektvollen Rahmen mitgestalten.

Die Anstellung erfolgt direkt bei unserer Klientin im Arbeitgebermodell. Mehr als Eins unterstützt im Rahmen der Budgetassistenz und Vermittlung.

Über unsere Klientin

Unsere Klientin lebt mit zwei Hunden und einer Katze. Außerdem erwartet sie ein Kind, was Ende des Jahres zur Welt kommen wird. Sie sucht Assistenzpersonen, die sie im Alltag, bei Terminen und in ihrer Selbstständigkeit und Teilhabe verlässlich begleiten.

Deine Aufgaben

- Unterstützung bei Alltagsaufgaben, auch im Haushalt
- Sicherheit und Orientierung vermitteln
- Erinnern an Essen, Trinken und an alltägliche Aufgaben
- Begleitung zu Terminen, Arztbesuchen und Freizeitaktivitäten z.B. bei regelmäßigen Gassi-Runden mit den Hunden im Wald
- Ruhige Präsenz im Alltag und in belastenden Situationen
- Begleitung im Ehrenamt als Peer-Beraterin (nach dem Mutterschutz)

Was du mitbringst

- Feingefühl, Zuverlässigkeit und eine ruhige Art
- Respektvoller Umgang mit persönlichen Grenzen
- Besondere Verschwiegenheit und hohes Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein
- Traumasensible Unterstützung und die Bereitschaft sich weiterzubilden
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Keine Tierhaarallergie oder Ängste
- Quereinsteiger*innen willkommen
- Hilfreich, aber kein Muss:
Erfahrung im sozialen, pädagogischen oder assistenznahen Bereich.
Sowie Erfahrung mit traumatisierten Menschen und Babys/Kindern.

Wir bieten

- 18,90 EUR pro Stunde
- Beschäftigung in Teilzeit oder als Midijob (kein Minijob), 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen der Assistenzplanung, auch an Sonn- und Feiertagen
- Zuschläge für Sonn-, Feiertags- und Nachtarbeit, jeweils steuer- und sozialversicherungsfrei
- 6 Wochen Urlaub
- Regelmäßige Supervision
- Grundschulung zum Thema Trauma zu Beginn
- Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe

Wichtig für diese Tätigkeit

Wichtig ist, Sicherheit durch berechenbares Verhalten, klare Kommunikation und respektvollen Umgang zu vermitteln.

Eine gewisse Lebens- oder Berufserfahrung ist hilfreich. Entscheidend sind jedoch Haltung, Verlässlichkeit und Reflexionsfähigkeit.

Bewerbung

Bei Interesse freuen wir uns über eine kurze Bewerbung mit Angaben zu Motivation, Verfügbarkeit und ggf. relevanter Erfahrung über unser Karriereportal

Hinweis: Kosten, die im Rahmen des Bewerbungsverfahrens entstehen – insbesondere Fahrtkosten zu einem Vorstellungsgespräch – können von uns leider nicht übernommen werden

title: Head of Division Platforms & Infrastructure (m/w/d) (Leiter/in - IT)
description:
In der Zentralfunktion IT der Zeppelin GmbH am Standort Garching bei München suchen wir zum nächstmöglichsten Zeitpunkt einen „Head of Division Platforms & Infrastructure (m/w/d)“:

Darauf haben Sie Lust:
* Als „Head of Division Platforms & Infrastructure (m/w/d)“ übernehmen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für den stabilen, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen Betrieb der IT-Infrastruktur von Zeppelin
* Sie gestalten und steuern die Transformation der IT-Landschaft hin zu modernen, cloudorientierten und hochautomatisierten Plattformen
* Dabei entwickeln Sie eine nachhaltige Cloud‑ und Hosting‑Strategie mit Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Resilienz, Automatisierung und Wirtschaftlichkeit
* Sie verantworten die Weiterentwicklung der konzernweiten Plattformarchitektur – einschließlich Standardisierung, Infrastructure as Code und serviceorientierten Betriebsmodellen
* Sie führen mehrere spezialisierte Teams fachlich und disziplinarisch (z. B. Core Services, Managed Client, OS/DB Operations, Platform Services, End User Services, Identity Governance, Service Provider Management)
* Für den IT-Service-Desk und den Vor-Ort-Support stellen Sie eine hohe Servicequalität und Nutzerzufriedenheit sicher
* Durch einen leistungsfähigen Netzwerkbetrieb (LAN, WAN, VPN, WLAN) und einen stabilen Plattformbetrieb gewährleisten Sie einen sicheren und reibungslosen IT-Service – inklusive Monitoring sowie Incident-, Problem- und Performance-Management
* Identity & Access Management, Active Directory sowie moderne Sicherheits‑ und Compliance‑Architekturen entwickeln Sie kontinuierlich weiter
* Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf der Steuerung externer Dienstleister – insbesondere internationaler Offshore-Partner –, um eine effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Leistungserbringung sicherzustellen
* Zudem verantworten Sie Budget, Ressourcen und Roadmaps und treiben die Weiterentwicklung der gesamten Plattform- und Infrastrukturorganisation über KPIs und Zielsysteme voran

Das wünschen wir uns:
* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
* Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung in der Leitung von IT‑Infrastrukturbereichen, IT‑Teams und/oder IT‑Projekten, idealerweise auf Abteilungs‑ oder Bereichsleiterebene in einer internationalen oder Matrixorganisation
* Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Outsourcing und der Steuerung externer IT‑Dienstleister, einschließlich Zusammenarbeit mit Offshore‑Partnern
* Fundierte Erfahrung in der Transformation von Legacy‑Systemen zu modernen, cloudbasierten Plattformen (inkl. Migrationsstrategien, Modernisierung und Architektur‑Redesign)
* Umfassende Erfahrung im Betrieb hybrider IT‑Landschaften (On‑Premise und Cloud)
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse im IT‑Service‑Management, insbesondere ITIL, Service Desk, Incident‑ und Problem‑Management
* Tiefgehendes Know‑how in Cloud‑Technologien (z. B. Azure, AWS), Netzwerkinfrastrukturen, Identity & Access Management sowie Digital‑Workplace‑Lösungen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in IAM‑Systemen, insbesondere Active Directory, Berechtigungskonzepten und Sicherheitsrichtlinien
* Sehr gutes Verständnis von IT‑Security, Risiko‑ und Compliance‑Anforderungen (z. B. ISO 27001, DSGVO)
* Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen und interdisziplinären Teams sowie im Stakeholder‑Management auf C‑Level
* Ausgeprägte Führungsstärke, Kommunikationsfähigkeit und strategisches Denkvermögen
* Sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Darauf können Sie sich freuen:
* Einzigartige Unternehmenskultur: Basierend auf den Werten von Ferdinand Graf von Zeppelin handeln wir als Stiftungsunternehmen zukunftsorientiert, sozial und nachhaltig.
* We are sustainable: Wir leben den Schutz von Umwelt und Klima. Und das meinen wir ernst: Bis 2030 werden wir Zeppelin im laufenden Geschäftsbetrieb klimaneutral machen.
* Gestaltungsspielraum:  Bei uns bekommen Sie die Möglichkeit, Themen eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben.
* Mit Zeppelin wachsen: Wir unterstützen Sie mit umfangreichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einem vielseitigen Weiterbildungsprogramm.
* Z Colourful:  Wir arbeiten mit gezielten Aktivitäten, wie zum Beispiel unserem Frauennetzwerk und unseren Impulsreihen an der Verankerung von Vielfalt und deren Wertschätzung bei Zeppelin.
* Work-Life-Balance:  Wir bieten Ihnen mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten und dazu 30 Tage Urlaub. Zudem haben wir verschiedene Angebote und Initiativen rund um die Themen Gesundheit, Kinder und Pflege.
* Gesundheit und Bewegung: Über unsere Initiative ZFIT können Sie an verschiedenen Themenwochen und Yogastunden teilnehmen oder auch ein Firmenfahrrad leasen.
* Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir stocken Ihre Rente auf.

title: Compliance Manager (m/f/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
description:
Ref. 121987 – Compliance Manager (m/f/d)

The WIRTGEN GROUP, a Deere & Company business, is a global leader in road construction and materials processing equipment, serving customers through five established product brands and an international network of manufacturing, sales, service, and dealer operations. As part of Deere & Company, WIRTGEN GROUP combines its deep industry expertise, strong customer relationships, and distinct business heritage with Deere’s global capabilities, values, and commitment to integrity. WIRTGEN GROUP and Deere operate within a shared Ethics and Compliance function, supported by common program expectations, systems, policies, and standards of ethical business conduct.

Deere and Company’s Global Ethics and Compliance department is looking for a

Compliance Manager (m/f/d)

The Compliance Manager serves as the primary Ethics and Compliance partner for WIRTGEN GROUP globally, helping foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, and responsible business conduct across a complex international organization. The role operates as a broad-based compliance generalist, providing practical guidance and support across the full spectrum of ethics and compliance matters. Working closely with WIRTGEN GROUP stakeholders and businesses and the broader Deere and Company Ethics and Compliance team, this role supports compliance program implementation, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and the continued alignment of WIRTGEN GROUP into Deere and Company’s enterprise compliance framework.  The position is located in WIRTGEN GROUP’s headquarters, based in Windhagen, Germany.

Your Responsibilities:

- Serve as the primary Compliance Manager supporting WIRTGEN GROUP globally, acting as the strategic interface on compliance risks, program expectations, regulatory matters, and alignment with Deere and Company’s Ethics and Compliance strategy
- Provide practical, business-oriented compliance guidance across a broad range of matters, including but not limited to: anti-bribery and anti-corruption, fraud risk, third-party relationships, trade compliance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, training, policy and regulatory interpretation, and employee questions or concerns.
- Implement, maintain, monitor, and manage compliance program elements for WIRTGEN GROUP, including policies, controls, third-party risk management activities, training, communications, monitoring, and reporting processes.
- Use data analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI capabilities to identify compliance trends, strengthen risk visibility, improve monitoring and reporting, and support more informed, risk-based decision-making, consistent with company policies and responsible AI principles.
- Partner with business leaders and functional stakeholders to identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks, translating those risks into practical recommendations and actions.
- Support compliance risk assessments and related remediation activities, including the collection and analysis of information, documentation of findings, development of mitigation plans, and monitoring of agreed actions.
- Support the continued alignment of WIRTGEN GROUP into Deere’s global compliance framework by helping implement enterprise policies, procedures, systems, controls, and compliance expectations across relevant operations, functions, and markets.
- Collaborate with Deere and Company’s Compliance Managers to identify, evaluate, escalate, and address compliance risks across multiple countries and jurisdictions.
- Facilitate information sharing and risk visibility for WIRTGEN and Deere and Company stakeholders, including emerging, complex, and cross-border compliance matters.
- Develop and support risk-based compliance training, communications, monitoring activities, management reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with WIRTGEN GROUP and Deere stakeholders, providing guidance, coaching, and support while promoting a culture of integrity, ethical behavior, transparency, and accountability.

What Skills You Need:

- At least 5 years of practical experience working as a compliance specialist, compliance manager, or similar professional supporting a company’s broader ethics and compliance needs.
- Experience supporting or managing multiple elements of a corporate ethics and compliance program, such as risk assessment, training and communications, policy guidance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, fraud risk, trade compliance, monitoring, or reporting.
- Ability to operate as a compliance generalist, recognize issues across different compliance disciplines, provide sound initial guidance, and engage subject-matter specialists when appropriate.
- Strong business judgment and the ability to translate policies, regulatory expectations, and compliance requirements into practical guidance for business stakeholders.
- Ability to build relationships, establish credibility, and influence stakeholders across multiple cultures, business functions, organizational levels, and regions.
- Strong analytical, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage complex issues and competing priorities while maintaining high standards of integrity, discretion, and accountability.
- Professional proficiency in both English and German.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience supporting an international or multinational business with manufacturing, sales, service, distribution, or dealer operations.
- Working knowledge of anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, trade and sanctions compliance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, fraud risk, corporate codes of conduct, or investigatory practices.
- Experience conducting compliance risk assessments, developing risk mitigation plans, and monitoring remediation activities.
- Experience developing or delivering compliance training, communications, monitoring activities, dashboards, and management reporting.
- Ability to influence senior leaders and drive change through collaboration, credibility, and trust.
- Experience in process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Proficiency in additional languages.

Education:

Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:

- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent level in Business Administration, Law, Compliance, Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Public Policy, or a related field

In addition to the gross monthly salary, the salary for this position (full-time) consists of various special payments. Depending on your experience, you can expect monthly starting salary of between 7,463 and 11,194 EUR in this position.

This exempt position is based in Windhagen, requires a regular on-site presence and it is vacant as soon as possible.

Job Grade: 9

End of Posting: 05.11.2026

We are committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive workplace where everyone can feel welcome, supported, and able to contribute. We look forward to receiving your online application in English language!

title: Schulbegleitung (m/w/d) mit pädagogischer Ausbildung in Teilzeit in der Gemeinde Ratekau (Schulbegleiter/in)
description:
Jeder Mensch ist einzigartig! Die Wertschätzung und Annahme der Menschen in ihrer Verschiedenheit und Vielfalt bilden das Fundament unserer Arbeit.

Wir, die Lebenshilfe Ostholstein e. V., sind ein gemeinnütziger Verein mit Sitz in der Marmeladen-Hauptstadt Bad Schwartau. In unserer 59-jährigen Geschichte haben wir uns mit über 315 Mitarbeiter*innen zu einer leistungsstarken Organisation mit vielfältigen Angeboten für Kinder, Jugendliche und erwachsene Menschen mit und ohne Behinderung entwickelt. Wir leisten Hilfe zur Selbsthilfe, stärken Selbstwert und -achtung, Eigenständigkeit, Toleranz und Akzeptanz. Bei uns findest Du eine sinnstiftende Arbeit und kannst Deinen Teil zur Inklusion und gleichberechtigten Teilhabe im und am Leben beitragen.

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt zur Verstärkung unseres Teams eine Schulbegleitung in Teilzeit (m/w/d) mit pädagogischer Ausbildung in der Gemeinde Ratekau.

Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:

- Un­ter­stüt­zung von Schülerinnen und Schülern in der Klasse in Abstimmung mit der ver­ant­wort­li­chen Lehr­kraft
- Be­glei­tung in den Pau­sen
- pflegerische Tätigkeiten
- Un­ter­stüt­zung in Über­for­de­rungs­si­tu­a­ti­o­nen sowie sozial-emotionale Begleitung
- För­de­rung so­zi­a­ler Kom­pe­ten­zen, der Kom­mu­ni­ka­ti­on und In­ter­ak­ti­on
- Be­glei­tung und Be­auf­sich­ti­gung wäh­rend schu­li­scher Son­der­ver­an­stal­tun­gen
- Zu­sam­men­ar­beit mit Lehrkräften so­wie anderen Fach­kräf­ten und dem Pooling-Team.

Wir bieten Dir:

- einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
- einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsplatz in einem kompetenten Team
- Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf
- ein tariflich geregeltes Beschäftigungsverhältnis nach dem TV Ostholstein
- eine Vergütung in Anlehnung an den TVÖD SuE (je nach Ausbildung eingruppiert in SuE 3 oder SuE 8a)
- Vermögenswirksame Leistungen und betriebliche Altersversorge
- 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich den 24. und 31.12. frei

Dein Profil:

- Fachkraft mit pädagogischer Ausbildung
- Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern mit Beeinträchtigung
- einen respektvollen und wertschätzenden Umgang mit den uns anvertrauten Kindern

Einstellungsvoraussetzungen

Bei Einstellung benötigen wir einen gültigen Impfnachweis Masern, einen Nachweis nach § 43 Abs.1 Nr.1 Infektionsschutzgesetz, einen aktuellen Erste-Hilfe-Nachweis (jeweils nicht älter als 1 Jahr) sowie ein aktuelles erweitertes Führungszeugnis (nicht älter als 3 Monate).

Möchtest Du einen Teil zu unserer Arbeit beitragen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung bis zum 08. November 2026.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

• Planning of reusable load carriers in the field of motors, axles, transmissions and batteries
• Creation of packaging concepts and project planning of new load carrier concepts in automotive production

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.
Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Ræsting/Cleaning
description:
*Job Title:** Housekeeping & Breakfast Attendant
**Location:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógar, Iceland
**Position:** Full-Time
**Start Date:** November 15, 2026

Hótel Skógafoss and Hótel Anna, located in the beautiful surroundings of South Iceland, are seeking a dedicated and versatile individual to join our team in a full-time capacity. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and reliable professional responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and ensuring our guests have a wonderful start to their day.

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Performing comprehensive cleaning of guest rooms and public areas to ensure a comfortable and welcoming environment.
* Managing all aspects of the daily breakfast service, including setting up and replenishing the buffet, and ensuring the dining area is clean and well-presented.
* Handling the hotel's laundry services, including washing, drying, and folding linens.
* Providing excellent customer service, assisting guests with inquiries, and processing payments for breakfast when required.

**The Ideal Candidate:**
* Has proven experience in housekeeping and/or food and beverage service.
* Is fluent in English and possesses excellent communication skills. Proficiency in other languages is a strong asset.
* Holds a valid B-category driver's license.
* Is a dependable team player with a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.
* Is flexible and willing to work a varied schedule.

**What We Offer:**
* A stable, full-time position in a friendly and dynamic work environment.
* Competitive wages according to the collective bargaining agreement with the VLFS union.
* **On-site accommodation is available for a fee.**
* The opportunity to live and work in one of Iceland's most scenic areas.

**How to Apply:**
We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.

Interested parties are requested to send an application along with a CV to the email address: johann@ejhotels.is or applications@ejhotels.is
Last application date is November 15th , 2026.

**Starfsheiti:** Umsjónaraðili herbergja og morgunverðar
**Staðsetning:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógum
**Starfshlutfall:** Fullt starf
**Starf hefst:** 15. nóvember 2026

Hótel Skógafoss og Hótel Anna, staðsett í hinu fallega umhverfi Suðurlands, óska eftir að ráða þjónustulundaðan og fjölhæfan einstakling í fullt starf. Leitum að ábyrgum og traustum aðila sem hefur metnað til að viðhalda ýtrustu kröfum um hreinlæti og tryggja að gestir okkar fái frábæra byrjun á deginum.

**Helstu verkefni og ábyrgðarsvið:**
* Umfangsmikil þrif á herbergjum og sameiginlegum rýmum hótelsins til að tryggja snyrtilegt og notalegt umhverfi.
* Fullnaðarumsjón með morgunverðarþjónustu, þ.m.t. undirbúningur og áfylling á hlaðborð.
* Umsjón með þvotti hótelsins, s.s. þvottur, þurrkun og frágangur á líni.
* Veita framúrskarandi þjónustu, aðstoða gesti og taka við greiðslum fyrir morgunverð þegar við á.

**Hæfniskröfur:**
* Sönnuð reynsla af þrifum og/eða störfum í veitingaþjónustu er skilyrði.
* Mjög góð enskukunnátta og framúrskarandi samskiptahæfni. Kunnátta í öðrum tungumálum er mikill kostur.
* Gilt ökuskírteini (B-flokkur) er skilyrði.
* Áreiðanleiki, jákvæðni og hæfni til að vinna vel í hóp.
* Sveigjanleiki og vilji til að vinna á breytilegum vöktum.

**Það sem við bjóðum:**
* Öruggt fullt starf á vinalegum og lifandi vinnustað.
* Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi við VLFS.
* **Húsnæði er í boði á staðnum gegn gjaldi.**
* Einstakt tækifæri til að búa og starfa á einum fallegasta stað landsins.

**Umsóknir:**
Farið er yfir umsóknir jafnóðum.

Áhugasamir vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: johann@ejhotels.is or applications@ejhotels.is
Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 31.okt 2026.

title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS
Employment percentage: 75–100%
Application deadline: 30 September 2026

Further Information
Ragnhildur Jónsdóttir
Chief Physiotherapist
Email: ragnhildur@sak.is
Phone: 852-5608

Apply for the position on following link: https://island.is/starfatorg/x-0260be8b-c4ee-4c87-ba29-9ed083fd4e02
Application deadline: 20 october 2026

Við leitum að sjúkraþjálfara í okkar góða hóp á Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri (SAk). Um er að ræða 75-100% ótímabundna stöðu og er staðan laus nú þegar eða eftir nánara samkomulagi.

Sjúkraþjálfarar við Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri starfa á bráðadeildum sjúkrahússins við Eyrarlandsveg og/eða á endurhæfingadeild. Vegna flutninga endurhæfingardeildar af Kristnesi verður nú annars vegar starfrækt legudeild endurhæfingar í húsnæði SAk á Eyrarlandsholti og hins vegar dag- og göngudeild utan spítalans. Þar mun fara fram þverfagleg endurhæfing á einstaklingsgrunni og/eða í hópum. Staðsetning starfs getur farið eftir áhugasviði umsækjenda.

Um er að ræða dagvinnu, vinnuvika starfsfólks í fullu starfi er nú 36 klst. Við það bætast stöku sinnum vaktir um helgar og á lögbundnum frídögum við bráðadeildir sjúkrahússins, sem greitt er aukalega fyrir og gefur aukna tekjumöguleika.

Starfið er fjölbreytt og býður upp á frábær tækifæri til að afla sér faglegrar og sérhæfðrar þekkingar og taka þátt í uppbyggingu dag- og göngudeildar á nýjum stað. Við tökum vel á móti nýju fólki og veitum góða aðlögun undir handleiðslu reyndra sjúkraþjálfara. Kjörið tækifæri fyrir reynslubolta sem og nýútskrifaða til að dýpka þekkingu og verða hluti af öflugri liðsheild.

Helstu verkefni og ábyrgð
Almenn vinna sjúkraþjálfara í þverfaglegu umhverfi

Fræðsla til sjúklinga og aðstandenda

Þverfaglegt samstarf innan deilda

Verkefni og ábyrgð eru í samræmi við reynslu

Þátttaka í faglegri þróun

Hæfniskröfur
Fullgilt próf í sjúkraþjálfun og íslenskt starfsleyfi

Við ráðningu verður lögð áhersla á faglega þekkingu, reynslu og áhuga, sjálfstæði í vinnubrögðum og hæfileika í samskiptum og samvinnu

Gerð er krafa um vammleysi, s.s. að vera með gott orðspor og að framkoma og athafnir á vinnustað og utan hans samrýmist starfinu

Hreint sakavottorð

Frekari upplýsingar um starfið
Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi sem fjármála- og efnahagsráðherra og Félag sjúkraþjálfara hafa gert.

Allar umsóknir þurfa að fara rafrænt í gegnum ráðningarkerfi ríkisins. Umsóknum skulu fylgja ítarlegar upplýsingar um nám og starfsferilskrá ásamt afriti af prófskírteinum og starfsleyfi, ef við á. Tekið er mið af jafnréttisstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri við ráðningar í störf á sjúkrahúsinu. Umsóknir geta gilt í 6 mánuði frá birtingu auglýsingar, sbr. 3. tl. 2. mgr. 2. gr. reglna nr. 1000/2019 um auglýsingar lausra starfa með síðari breytingum. Öllum umsóknum verður svarað.

Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri veitir alþjóðlega DNV-GL vottaða heilbrigðisþjónustu með ISO vottuðu gæðastjórnunarkerfi þar sem áhersla er á virka þátttöku allra starfsmanna til að uppfylla þær gæðakröfur sem gerðar eru í alþjóðlegum staðli sem sjúkrahúsið er vottað eftir.

Samkvæmt mannauðsstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri er lögð áhersla á að ráða til starfa og halda í hæfileikaríka einstaklinga. Við val á starfsfólki er menntun, reynsla, færni og hæfni höfð að leiðarljósi. Mannauðsstefnan er leiðarljós stjórnenda og starfsfólks sem gerir sjúkrahúsið framsækinn og eftirsóknarverðan vinnustað, en hún byggir á grunngildum sjúkrahússins sem eru: ÖRYGGI, SAMVINNA og FRAMSÆKNI.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS
Employment percentage: 75–100%
Application deadline: 30 September 2026

Further Information

Chief Physiotherapist

Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi sem fjármála- og efnahagsráðherra og Félag sjúkraþjálfara hafa gert.

Allar umsóknir þurfa að fara rafrænt í gegnum ráðningarkerfi ríkisins. Umsóknum skulu fylgja ítarlegar upplýsingar um nám og starfsferilskrá ásamt afriti af prófskírteinum og starfsleyfi, ef við á. Tekið er mið af jafnréttisstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri við ráðningar í störf á sjúkrahúsinu. Umsóknir geta gilt í 6 mánuði frá birtingu auglýsingar, sbr. 3. tl. 2. mgr. 2. gr. reglna nr. 1000/2019 um auglýsingar lausra starfa með síðari breytingum. Öllum umsóknum verður svarað.

Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri veitir alþjóðlega DNV-GL vottaða heilbrigðisþjónustu með ISO vottuðu gæðastjórnunarkerfi þar sem áhersla er á virka þátttöku allra starfsmanna til að uppfylla þær gæðakröfur sem gerðar eru í alþjóðlegum staðli sem sjúkrahúsið er vottað eftir.

Samkvæmt mannauðsstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri er lögð áhersla á að ráða til starfa og halda í hæfileikaríka einstaklinga. Við val á starfsfólki er menntun, reynsla, færni og hæfni höfð að leiðarljósi. Mannauðsstefnan er leiðarljós stjórnenda og starfsfólks sem gerir sjúkrahúsið framsækinn og eftirsóknarverðan vinnustað, en hún byggir á grunngildum sjúkrahússins sem eru: ÖRYGGI, SAMVINNA og FRAMSÆKNI.

title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

description:

FNZ is the global platform provider in the wealth management sector, partnering with over 650 of the world’s leading financial institutions and over 8,000 wealth management firms. With over 5,000 employees in 24 countries, FNZ’s mission is to open-up wealth, empowering all people to create wealth through personal investment, aligned with things they care about the most, on their own terms. The key responsibilities of the department include: Providing a high-quality Fund Accounting service to FNZ Ireland's clients and acting as a key point of contact for operational and accounting queries. Producing accurate and timely fund valuations and Net Asset Values (NAVs), ensuring all deadlines and regulatory requirements are met. Reviewing and analysing fund accounting information to identify and resolve discrepancies. Executing trades with international fund managers in accordance with client mandates and investment guidelines. Managing treasury activities and monitoring cash positions to ensure efficient liquidity management. Recording, reviewing and validating fund transactions in an accurate and timely manner. Performing complex reconciliations and investigating reconciling items to resolution. Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial and statutory reporting requirements. Liaising directly with clients, custodians, fund managers, brokers, auditors and banking partners on operational matters. Supporting new client onboarding, fund launches and change initiatives. Identifying opportunities to improve processes, controls and operational efficiency. Assisting in the training and development of junior team members and providing guidance on day-to-day activities. Utilising FNZ's technology platforms and reporting tools to investigate issues and enhance service delivery. Ensuring all activities are performed in line with internal controls, policies and regulatory requirements. The Person The ideal candidate will have previous experience in Fund Accounting, Investment Operations, Financial Services Operations or a related discipline. They will demonstrate strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to take ownership of deliverables within a fast-paced environment. They should also have: A degree in Commerce, Business Studies, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Mathematics or a related discipline. 1-3 years' experience in Fund Accounting, Financial Services, Investment Operations or a similar role. A strong understanding of fund accounting FNZ combines technology, infrastructure and investment operations in a single state-of-the-art platform that frees its institutional customers to create hyper-personalized and innovative products and services, that are seamlessly aligned with the needs of their clients.

title: Welder/Fabricator
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
A Welder/Fabricator in a Steel Engineering Company plays a crucial role in the process of turning raw steel materials into usable components for various construction and engineering projects. Their responsibilities encompass a range of tasks related to cutting, shaping, assembling, and welding steel pieces to create structural and architectural elements. Key roles and responsibilities of a Steel Fabricator: Material Preparation: Review engineering drawings, blueprints, and specifications to understand the required dimensions and tolerances. Select appropriate steel materials based on project requirements and specifications. Measure and mark steel pieces for cutting and shaping using tools such as tape measures, squares, and marking devices. Cutting and Shaping: Operate various cutting equipment, such as saws, shears, plasma cutters, and torches, to cut steel pieces according to the provided specifications. Use bending machines, presses, and rollers to shape steel components as required by the design. 3. Welding and Assembly: Assemble steel components by welding, bolting, riveting, or other joining methods specified in the engineering plans. Perform welding using different techniques such as MIG (Metal Inert Gas), TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas), and stick welding, ensuring strong and durable connections. Ensure proper alignment, fit, and finish of assembled components, maintaining structural integrity and aesthetic appearance. Quality Control: Inspect fabricated parts for accuracy, quality, and conformance to specifications. Identify and address any defects, inconsistencies, or imperfections in the fabrication process. Conduct quality checks using measuring tools like calipers, gauges, and squares. Safety and Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines while working with heavy machinery, cutting tools, and welding equipment. Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure personal safety and prevent workplace accidents. Follow industry standards and regulations to ensure that the fabricated components meet required codes and standards. Collaboration: Communicate with engineers, designers, and other team members to clarify design details and resolve any issues that arise during fabrication. Collaborate with other fabricators and tradespeople to coordinate the assembly and installation of larger structures. Maintenance and Troubleshooting: Perform routine maintenance on fabrication equipment to ensure proper functioning and longevity. Troubleshoot and address equipment malfunctions or breakdowns to minimize downtime. Documentation: Maintain accurate records of materials used, time spent, and work completed for each project. Document any modifications or changes made during the fabrication process. Continuous Learning: Stay updated on advancements in fabrication techniques, equipment, and materials to enhance skills and knowledge.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: Offaly, Co Offaly About the Role: Irish HomeCare is seeking qualified and experienced Healthcare Assistants to join our growing team in Offaly. Successful candidates will be responsible for providing home care services to our clients in the local community. Key Responsibilities: Provide personal, non-medical care and assistance to clients in their own homes Assist with clients’ physical, nutritional and social needs as laid out in their Care Plan. These duties may include providing personal care (e.g., washing, dressing, assisting with continence care), mobilising, assistance with feeding, meal preparation, light housekeeping, etc. Requirements: A major award in Health or Social Care or equivalent (Qualified to Level 5 on the QQI Framework) Previous care or healthcare experience A general understanding of geriatric health and mobility issues Strong verbal communication skills and good command of spoken and written English A full Irish (or Irish recognised) Driving Licence and access to a vehicle is essential Hours of Work: 39 hours per week Must be available to work various shifts, including mornings, afternoons and evenings (including weekends and bank holidays) Salary: €32,691 per annum Benefits: Refer a Friend scheme Christmas Bonus To Please submit your application to jobs@irishhomecare.ie by 5pm on 10th Nov 2026

Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. You will be the go-to person to ensure plant efficiency and safety through: Pure Problem Solving: Fast diagnosis and corrective maintenance during breakdowns to get the line running safely again. Strategy: Preventive and predictive maintenance during scheduled shutdowns. Continuous Improvement: Small optimization tweaks on machinery and equipment to make a real difference. Teamwork & Networking: Supporting external technicians during installations and testing, and managing shift handovers. Knowledge Sharing: Providing basic training to line operators (set-ups, format changes, OPL procedures). Organization: Keeping the workshop and spare parts warehouse in perfect order. The ideal profile we are looking for: We want someone eager to learn with a solid technical foundation: Education: Technical diploma (Electrical, Electrotechnical, Mechanical, or Mechatronics). Experience: Already worked in industrial maintenance? Great. If you are a junior profile but have high motivation and a strong technical base, we still want to meet you and invest in your growth. Hard Skills: Ability to read electrical schematics, knowledge of components (sensors, motors, wiring), and a good grasp of mechanics and pneumatics. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork attitude, flexibility, and a result-oriented mindset. Pluses: Basic English and any specific technical certifications are highly valued. What's in it for you (The Offer): Top-tier Environment: Join a well-structured, clean corporate environment equipped with modern technologies. Real Growth: Structured initial onboarding and a continuous technical development path. Solid Contract: Italian 'CCNL Metalmeccanica Industria' (Indicative classification D2 - C2 based on your experience). Competitive Salary: Indicative Gross Annual Salary (RAL) €25,000 - €35,000 + allowances (shifts, on-call, overtime) + company benefits and annual bonuses. Hours and Location: Shift Pattern: Full-time, organized on shifts (06-14 / 14-22 / 08-17). Location: Florence, Italy. Ready to power up your career? Send us your CV today and let's have a chat! #LI-ML7 Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Il nostro Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Ricerca e Selezione, Consulenza HR, Formazione, Outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Siamo presenti in più di 30 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 6000 persone. I valori che ci contraddistinguono: attenzione, passione, apprendimento continuo e innovazione, collaborazione, sostenibilità, responsabilità. title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)
