title: Relationship Manager (m/f)
description:
Description:


At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.


What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

- Fachliche und organisatorische Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung des Hochbau-Teams
- Steuerung der Projekte hinsichtlich Qualität, Terminen und Ressourceneinsatz

- Begleitung ausgewählter Projekte von der Konzeptphase bis zur Ausführung und Abnahme

- Mehrjährige fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Tragwerksplanung, insbesondere im Massiv- und idealerweise Holzbau

Job Details

Position Type:  Full Time
Job ID:  26127332
Career area:  Food and Beverage & Culinary
Location(s):  Luxembourg Marriott Hotel Alfa

JOB SUMMARY

Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met

• Manages kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
• Estimates daily production needs on a weekly basis and communicates production needs to kitchen personnel daily.
• Assists Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and preparation.
• Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
• Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.
• Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
• Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
• Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
• Performs all duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary.
• Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
• Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
• Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
• Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
• Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.

Leading Kitchen Operations

• Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
• Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
• Maintains the productivity level of employees.
• Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer to join to the internal Finance department.

Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Position Summary

The Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer is responsible for optimizing the Company's cash flow by managing accounts receivable, reducing credit risk, improving collection performance, and supporting treasury activities. The role combines operational cash collection, credit risk management, reporting, business partnering, legal recovery coordination, and continuous process improvement.

What will you do?

Cash Collection & Accounts Receivable

• Manage customer accounts, handle accounts receivable, and ensure the timely collection of outstanding invoices.
• Coordinate reminder campaigns and follow up on payment commitments.
• Escalate overdue cases in line with the Cash Recovery Policy.
• Negotiate payment arrangements and coordinate legal recovery when required.
• Resolve payment issues in collaboration with Partners, Project Managers and client teams.

Credit Risk Management

• Implement a client credit rating system.
• Maintain and update client and group risk ratings.
• Monitor payment behaviour, financial exposure and insolvency indicators.
• Recommend credit terms, collection strategies and risk mitigation actions.
• Monitor customer insolvency risks, in particular by conducting checks with the Luxembourg Commercial Register (LBR).

Cash Management & Reporting

• Produce dashboards and KPI reports (DSO, ageing, cash collection, risk ratings, exposure, legal recovery and forecast accuracy).
• Contribute to the preparation of PowerBI reports.
• Present analyses and recommendations to Management and the Cash Recovery Committee.

Business Partnering

• Advise Partners and business teams on receivable management and credit risk.
• Promote timely billing, proactive collections and effective dispute resolution.
• Ensure compliance with the Company's Cash Recovery Policy and applicable legislation.

Process Improvement & Governance

• Continuously improve collection processes, reporting, workflows and internal controls.
• Contribute to the digitization of processes, particularly through AI.
• Maintain the Cash Recovery Policy, credit procedures and risk models.
• Coordinate with Partners, Treasury, Finance and external legal advisors.

Shared Service Center Coordination

• Act as the primary liaison between Luxembourg and the AR Team in Morocco.
• Occasional travels to Morocco to strengthen collaboration, monitor performance, deliver training and ensure consistent application of Finance procedures.

This position is for you if:

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years' experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Cash Management.
• Experience in a professional services environment is an asset.
• Team management.

Technical Skills

• Strong accounting and credit management knowledge.
• Advanced Excel skills; IA, Power BI and ERP experience are an advantage.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg accounting and VAT principles.

Personal Skills

• Analytical and results-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management.
• Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and cultures.

Languages

• English and French required.
• German and/or Luxembourgish are considered assets.
…then this offer is probably made for you!


What´s in it for you:

- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave

• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking

• Free access to our fitness room

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

title: Relationship Manager (m/f)
description:
Description:


At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.


What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

description:
HR Business Partner (M/W)

Rockids, a network of nurseries operated by the La Maison Bleue Group, supports children and their families every day through a caring, innovative educational approach focused on children's development. Rockids is a recognized leader in the early childhood sector and operates 24 small-scale centers across Luxembourg, where quality of care, educational excellence, and staff well-being are at the heart of every project.
Joining Rockids means becoming part of a leading international group in the early childhood sector while working within a local, close-knit organization.

As an HR Business Partner, you will help shape the company's HR practices, support managers in their day-to-day challenges, and foster a high-performing work environment that promotes employee development.

Your primary mission will be to support the company's growth by implementing and continuously improving the HR processes that underpin its development.

As a true partner to senior management and teams, you will work across a broad range of responsibilities, including recruitment, HR development, HR administration, project management, and employee relations.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

You will be responsible for the full recruitment process, from identifying staffing needs to onboarding new employees.
In this role, you will:

Supporting Managers and Teams

In particular, you will:

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

We are looking for an HR professional with at least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR role or as an HR Business Partner, ideally in a multi-site environment.

Working Conditions

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

title: Senior Product Manager, EU FBA Supply Chain (m/f)
description:
Senior Product Manager, EU FBA Supply Chain
Job ID: 10561353 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Removals Seller Experience within EU FBA Supply Chain. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll define strategy and build the roadmap for the 250M+ units (7% of outbound) removed from our network annually, partnering with WW FBA, tech and science, fulfillment operations, and seller experience teams to durably reduce removals damages, improve removals speed, and deliver the consolidation and traceability sellers need.

You're analytical, curious, and relentless. You ask "why" five times, work across org boundaries with ease, and obsess over the seller and customer experience. You bring high judgment, deep conviction, and the grit to turn complex, cross-functional problems into durable solutions.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the removals SX roadmap. Define product and program strategy to overhaul the end-to-end removal experience, from order creation through FC processing, carrier handoff, and delivery. Prioritize across three core seller frictions (damages, speed, and consolidation/traceability), balancing seller trust against cost-to-serve and FC capacity guardrails.
• Bring EU voice to the S-Team working group. Serve as a key member of the cross-team working group with WW FBA and all partner teams to finalize the S-Team Removals overhaul goal and feeder goals. Own and deliver on the EU feeder goals, reporting progress through the working group's mechanisms.
• Eliminate defects, damages, and cancellations. Build mechanisms to identify and resolve recurring defects at the root cause. Own the strategy to reduce inaccurate removals from system gaps. Deliver Seller-facing tools for damage reporting, claims resolution, and proactive communication.
• Fix removals speed and traceability. Drive removal lead time reduction by partnering with FC Operations and enable end-to-end removal tracking so sellers have full visibility from order creation to delivery.
• Scale automated removals. Drive auto-removal adoption by defining the engagement tiers (default, agentic, guided self-service) and the guardrails that give sellers control while enabling automation.
• Be the metric and mechanism owner. Define, instrument, and reporting on Removals SX metrics. Decompose into actionable drivers and size each opportunity. Build the business case, write the narratives (PRFAQ, OP1/OP2 inputs, MBR/QBR updates), and manage the review cadence with senior leadership.

About the team

Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years. Sellers can list and sell their products across all of our European sites from a single account. Description

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.

• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

description:
Network Planning Manager, MMNC - Middle Mile Network Control
Job ID: 10551620 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

This role tagged as one of Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to Retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Key job responsibilities

Define the Amazon outbound network planning (Legs, Sorts, CPT) for one of the UK sub-regions covered by 3-5 Sort Centers.
Analyse the best design based on forecast, and historical flows to improve cost, speed and DEA across E2E network.
Partner with teams to align on network changes to solve operational challenges.
Support the planning and organization of complex projects including Peak network transformations

A day in the life

Being a Network Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.

As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both on-the-ground tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.

This role is based in Luxembourg headquarters.

About the team

Amazon couldn't deliver at pace without the STEP TNO team. As part of STEP TNO MMNC, you'll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you'll help Amazon's transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.

We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f)
description:
Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f)

Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients.

Your role

• Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework.
• Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
• Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors).
• Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process.
• Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters.
• Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments.
• Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests.
• Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies.

Your skills and experience

• Master's degree in economics, finance, mathematics or a related field.
• At least 2 years of previous experience in risk management, control and/or audit functions.
• Good knowledge and understanding of the Luxembourg investment fund industry and the UCITS regulatory framework.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English; proficiency in French or Italian would be an asset.

Who we are

FundSight is an independent third-party Management Company (ManCo) based in Luxembourg, regulated by the CSSF and holding a dual AIFM and UCITS license as well as a MiFID authorization. Its business has been licensed since 1971 and was carved out and wholly acquired (100%) by BlackFin in 2025; FundSight has since been an independent company, with no operational or capital ties to Lemanik. It has a center of excellence in Porto, a branch in Paris, and representative offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. The Group is also established in New York and Atlanta. FundSight today supports more than 120 institutional clients and manages more than €40 billion in assets under management. For more information: www.fundsight.com.

How to apply

If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to develop your career in a young, dynamic and international environment, please send your cover letter and detailed CV in English to recruitment@fundsight.com (reference: “Risk Officer – UCITS”).

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Before the employment agreement is signed, a copy of an official criminal record certificate (Bulletin No. 3), issued within the previous two months, must be provided for review.

title: Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team (m/f)
description:
Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team

Location  Leudelange
Experience Level  Experienced
Home Office  Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

• Within our International Non-Life department, we are building a new Pan-European business branch operating under the Freedom of Service (FoS) regime.
• Our ambition: bring innovative insurance solutions to B2B partners across Europe — from MGAs and brokers to corporate clients seeking fronting solutions for their captives.
• As Data and Process Manager, you will play a key role in structuring and supervising the entire data process exchange for our international operations.

• You will work within a multidisciplinary international team operating in start-up and agile mode, reporting directly to the Head of International Non-Life.

Financial Management and Data Quality:

• Manage operational financial flows and work closely with Finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate transmission of data.
• Ensure the consistency and reliability of technical and financial data, notably by overseeing proper data reconciliation with actuarial teams and collaborating with partners to enhance the integrity of incoming data flows.

Operational and Cross-Functional Support:

• Coordinate operations across internal teams and external partners.
• Support claims management, fraud investigations, and customer complaints handling, while assisting in the design and deployment of operational processes with partners.
• Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders whenever required.
• Take ownership of cross-functional topics and urgent requests that have not yet been allocated within the team, stepping in where necessary to ensure business continuity and the successful delivery of activities across functions.
Process Management and Cross-Functional Coordination:
• Define, formalize, document, and continuously improve business processes, including underwriting, claims management, data flows, and reporting.
• Actively manage workflow automation and digitalization initiatives in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
• Ensure that processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Identify operational pain points and drive problem-solving and process optimization initiatives.
• Act as a central coordination point between operational teams, IT, Finance, and external partners.
• Foster collaboration and ensure seamless coordination across teams to address operational challenges.
• Ensure the timely implementation of IT solutions with our partners and proactively remove any delivery blockers.
• Contribute to the implementation or enhancement of tools and systems supporting operational management.
• Identify opportunities for operational improvement and lead process optimization projects.

What we expect

• Master's degree (or equivalent, Bac+5) in Management, Engineering, Finance, Insurance, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a cross-functional role, with exposure to operational processes, technology, finance, data management, and business operations
• Proven experience in an international and/or multi-country environment is highly desirable
• Strong organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills, with a continuous improvement mindset
• Proven ability to thrive in complex, multicultural environments, ideally within agile or fast-growing organizations.
• Fluency in English (working language); additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) are an asset
• SQL language proficiency

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. Amazon Logistics (AMZL) delivers millions of packages to customers every day across Amazon's Last Mile network. title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

title: Medior asset management professional
description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

title: SHEQ Adviseur
description:
Minimaal mbo werk- en denkniveau, aangevuld met een MVK diploma
Ervaring als SHEQ Adviseur of vergelijkbare rol (bij voorkeur in civiele techniek, bouw, (hernieuwbare) energie, olie & gas, offshore, havens of mijnbouw)

Uitstekende beheersing van Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
Goede kennis van MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
Sterke coachende en communicatieve vaardigheden
Analytisch denkvermogen en oplossingsgericht
Motiverend en overtuigend richting collega s en externe partijen
Proactief, verantwoordelijk en kritisch
Ervaring met zwaar transport/hijswerk is een pré

Introductie
Word jij de SHEQ Adviseur die veiligheid, structuur en daadkracht brengt in complexe hijs- en transportprojecten?

Ben jij niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en medewerkers te coachen op veiligheidsbewustzijn? Dan is dit jouw kans om direct impact te maken!

Functieomschrijving
Als SHEQ Adviseur ben je de schakel die ervoor zorgt dat veiligheid en kwaliteit altijd op nummer één staan bij grote hijs en transportprojecten in regio Zeeland. Je bent betrokken bij uitdagende projecten in onder andere de petrochemie en zware industrie. Jij weet als geen ander hoe belangrijk het is om medewerkers en onderaannemers bewust te maken van risico s en zorgt ervoor dat het beleid niet alleen op papier staat, maar ook op de werkvloer wordt nageleefd.

In jouw dagelijkse werk coach en motiveer je collega s en externe partijen rondom veiligheid en gedrag. Je neemt deel aan SHEQ-overleggen, zowel intern als met klanten. Je analyseert incidenten, beoordeelt risico s en vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen. Dankzij jou worden audits soepel begeleid en rapportages betrouwbaar opgesteld. Je ondersteunt het management bij het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van het veiligheidsbeleid en stapt moeiteloos in als gesprekspartner voor operationele vragen.

Jouw belangrijkste taken:

Adviseren, trainen en coachen van medewerkers over operationele veiligheidsvraagstukken
Deelnemen aan SHEQ-overleggen (intern en extern)
Uitvoeren van incidentonderzoeken en risicoanalyses
Opstellen van SHEQ-rapportages en registreren van meldingen
Ondersteunen van het management bij veiligheidsbeleid en -ontwikkeling
Begeleiden van interne en externe audits

title: Technical Engineer
description:
Als Technical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud, verbeteren, ontwerpen, verbouwen en nieuwbouwen van productiemachines en randapparatuur. Je brengt techniek, betrouwbaarheid, productiviteit en onderhoud samen en speelt een belangrijke rol in het verder ontwikkelen van het machinepark. Werkzaamheden: ontwikkelen, verbeteren en implementeren van onderhoudsconcepten; analyseren en oplossen van complexe en terugkerende technische storingen; vertalen van productie-, slijtage- en storingsdata naar verbeteringen en re-engineering van productiemachines; inzetten van nieuwe technologieën om machines slimmer en efficiënter te maken; bijdragen aan een hogere productiesnelheid, minder afval, lager energieverbruik en betere productkwaliteit; produceren van nieuwe tooling (slijtdelen, stanshuizen en matrijzen) binnen de eigen gereedschapsmakerij; meedenken over refurbishing, aanpassingen en nieuwbouw van productiemachines. Je werkt binnen een klein technisch team met veel zelfstandigheid en ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen als engineer. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.255 en €3.882 (afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring); 8,33% vakantiegeld; 25 vakantiedagen; 4 collectieve vrije dagen; 92 ADV-uren; goede pensioenregeling; reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer; veel mogelijkheden voor opleiding en ontwikkeling; afwisselende fulltime functie in dagdienst; prettige werkomgeving met korte lijnen en betrokken collega's; veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en technische ontwikkeling. Wat levert deze baan jou op? Een zelfstandige fulltime functie in dagdienst binnen een technische productieomgeving waar volop wordt geïnvesteerd in medewerkers, techniek en machines. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en technische ontwikkeling, plus veel mogelijkheden voor opleiding en ontwikkeling en een prettige werkomgeving met korte lijnen en betrokken collega's. Functie-eisen Afgeronde technische mbo-4 opleiding; kennis van onderhoudsmethodieken binnen een

productieomgeving; duidelijke visie op innovatie en voorspelbaar onderhoud; minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Technical Engineer, Maintenance Engineer of vergelijkbare functie; sterke analytische vaardigheden; goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels; ervaring met CAD-tekenen en PLC-programmeren is een pré; proactieve houding; vermogen om met verschillende niveaus binnen een organisatie te communiceren; woonplaats binnen circa 25 kilometer van Heemskerk. Hier kom je te werken Onze opdrachtgever is een kleinschalige, internationale organisatie die al ruim 130 jaar actief is binnen de productie van industriële labels voor onder andere de tuinbouw, industrie en evenementensector. De organisatie werkt steeds meer met gerecyclede materialen en richt zich sterk op innovatie, kwaliteit en verduurzaming. Met ongeveer 30 medewerkers is sprake van een open en resultaatgerichte cultuur met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Omdat de organisatie actief is in een gespecialiseerde niche, zijn standaardmachines niet altijd geschikt voor het productieproces. Hierdoor wordt veel gewerkt aan het refurbishen, aanpassen en verbeteren van bestaande machines en daarnaast samen met gespecialiseerde leveranciers aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe machines.

Are you fascinated by how curiosity shapes learning in the classroom? Would you like to investigate how children seek information, explore and learn in real-world educational settings? If so, then we invite you to apply for this PhD position on Curiosity in the Classroom at Radboud University.
Curiosity is a powerful driver of learning, yet we still know relatively little about how curiosity unfolds in the classroom and how educational environments can support children in becoming curious and actively seeking information. In this PhD project, you will investigate curiosity in 10-to 12-year-old children within authentic educational settings.
The project combines experimental research, classroom studies and computational modelling to better understand what makes children curious, how they decide which information to explore, and how different ways of structuring learning environments influence curiosity and learning. Computational models will be used to characterise individual differences in information-seeking behaviour and to examine how these differences relate to learning in the classroom. title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician
description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity.

Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.

Job Description
You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry.
As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

  • Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
  • Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
  • Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
  • Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends

Profile

  • MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.


Employment Conditions

  • Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390

Important Notice
Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply.

Aan de hand van de eerder gemaakte basic engineering zijn we alle installaties fysiek in kaart gaan brengen. title: Magazijn Medewerker
description:
Magazijn Medewerker Location: Benschop
Als magazijnmedewerker zorg je er samen met je collega's voor dat dagelijks ongeveer 2.500 regels worden gepickt voor de productie, waarbij de goederen meerdere malen per dag via rolkooien worden afgeleverd.
Wat ga je doen?
Als Magazijn Medewerker werk je in een nieuw magazijn van 4.200 m² met circa 20.000 verschillende onderdelen in voorraad. Het magazijn is uitgerust met een automatisch OSR-systeem voor kleinere onderdelen en biedt een lichte werkplek met vloerverwarming en airconditioning. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat dagelijks ongeveer 2.500 regels worden gepickt voor de productie, waarbij de goederen meerdere malen per dag via rolkooien worden afgeleverd.
Het werk is zeer afwisselend omdat alle medewerkers worden opgeleid tot allround medewerker. Je krijgt een basistaak op een van de drie afdelingen: goederenontvangst, order pick of parts packing. Daarnaast bied je, indien nodig, ondersteuning op de andere afdelingen. Iedere afdeling wordt aangestuurd door een leidinggevende met wie je korte lijntjes onderhoudt.
Concreet betekent dit dat je breed wordt ingezet als allround magazijnmedewerker, ondersteund door 35 betrokken collega's, en werkt met alle voorkomende onderdelen van een terminal trekker.

title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician
description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity.

Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.

Job Description
You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry.
As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

  • Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
  • Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
  • Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
  • Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends

Profile

  • MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.


Employment Conditions

  • Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390

Important Notice
Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply.

title: Jouw ervaring in elektrotechniek voor de klas in Assen
description:
Je werkt minimaal 3 jaar in de elektrotechnische installatiebranche en wilt jouw praktijkervaring graag doorgeven. Je kent de NEN 1010 en NEN 3140 en weet hoe je deze toepast bij het inspecteren van elektrische laagspanningsinstallaties. Heb je al lesgegeven aan werkende volwassenen? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen. Ook zonder leservaring of docentenbevoegdheid horen we graag van je!

Krijg jij energie van elektrotechniek én van het moment waarop iemand jouw uitleg begrijpt? Bij Elektrovakopleidingen in Weert geef je jouw vakkennis door aan volwassenen die zich verder willen ontwikkelen in de elektrotechniek. Als Docent Elektrotechniek verzorg je theorie- en praktijklessen over het installeren, beheren en inspecteren van laagspanningsinstallaties. Je laat cursisten zien hoe ze de NEN 1010 en NEN 3140 in de praktijk toepassen en begeleidt hen bij het meten en beproeven. Met voorbeelden uit jouw eigen ervaring maak je de lesstof herkenbaar en begrijpelijk. De uitdaging? Iedere cursist brengt andere kennis, ervaring en vragen mee. Jij sluit daarop aan, helpt hen verder en ziet hoe hun vaardigheden en vertrouwen groeien. Daarnaast denk je mee over het verbeteren van ons lesmateriaal en onze cursussen. Je krijgt duidelijke lesstof om mee te werken en ruimte om jouw praktijkkennis in de lessen te verwerken. Elektrovakopleidingen is een opleidingsinstituut voor professionals in de elektrotechniek. In onze eigen theorie- en praktijklokalen combineren we actuele vakkennis met realistische oefeningen en persoonlijke begeleiding. Voor onze nieuwe locatie in Weert zoeken we een collega die samen met ons de opleidingen verder vormgeeft. Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten voor de ontwikkeling van andere vakmensen? Solliciteer of neem vrijblijvend contact met ons op. We maken graag kennis met je!

title: Monteur airco en warmtepompen
description:
Wie ben jij?
Allereerst ben je iemand die in het veld aan de slag wilt. Om de functie goed in te kunnen vullen, voldoet de ideale kandidaat aan onderstaande lijstje - mis je iets, laat je niet afschrikken en ga met ons in gesprek:
- Achtergrond in klimaat-, koel-, installatie-, en/of elektrotechniek.
- Ervaring als engineer met HVAC- en warmtepompsystemen.
- In het bezit van F-gassen en VCA.
- In het bezit van een rijbewijs B.
- Je spreekt goed Nederlands en kunt je verstaanbaar maken in het Engels.


Field engineer airco- en warmtepompsystemen
Met jouw kennis en ervaring in de airco- en warmtepompen, kunnen we jou om een boodschap sturen. Dit is jouw kans om je te binden aan één mooi merk en daarin te specialiseren rechtstreeks bij de fabrikant!

Wat ga je doen?
Oorspronkelijk bestaat de functie uit een combinatie van 80p in het veld en 20p op kantoor, waarbij je 100p bezig bent met de technische ondersteuning bij klanten.
- Buiten ben je voornamelijk bezig met de installatie, het onderhoud en de reparaties van onze HVAC- en warmtepompsystemen.
- Daarbij koppel je terug aan het service support team.
- Zorg je voor de juiste serviceonderdelen.
- En ben je het visitekaartje van ons serviceteam.
- Binnen ondersteun je het service support team.
- Waarbij je e-mails oppakt en technische vraagstukken beantwoordt.
- Je zorgt voor een rapportage aan de Service coordinator.
- En je helpt met het verbeteren van de app d.m.v. jouw veldervaringen.
- Regio Oost is daarbij een uitzondering, aangezien je verantwoordelijk wordt voor het gebied langs de A1 Utrecht - Apeldoorn. Dat betekent dat je volledig op de weg zit.

title: Allround Servicemonteur
description:
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het preventief- en correctief onderhoud van pneumatisch en hydraulisch equipment en pompen. De werkzaamheden worden zowel in de moderne werkplaats en op locatie uitgevoerd. Deze vacature is bedoeld voor een binnendienstfunctie.

Voor onze andere vacatures kijk ook even op www.werkenvoorhmb.nl

title: Service Planner
description: Als fulltime Service planner werk je nauw samen met de werkvoorbereiders binnen jouw afdeling. Aan jou de taak om voor de (service) monteurs in de Benelux een zo effectief en efficient mogelijke planning te maken.

title: Coördinator Dagbesteding Geelbroekerweg Hooghalen
description:
Als coördinator dagbesteding begeleid en ondersteun je bewoners met een intensieve begeleidingsvraag in hun dagelijks leven. Je coördineert de dagbesteding, vertaalt de doelen uit het persoonlijk plan naar passende activiteiten en stemt deze af met de persoonlijk begeleider, onder verantwoordelijkheid van de gedragsdeskundige. Binnen de Cirkel combineer je het werken op de dagbesteding met het werken op de woonlocatie. Zo zorg je samen met je collega's voor continuïteit, verbinding tussen wonen en dagbesteding en een eenduidige begeleidingsstijl.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, behandelaren, verwanten en andere betrokkenen. Je stimuleert bewoners in hun ontwikkeling, zelfredzaamheid en maatschappelijke participatie, rapporteert over de voortgang en denkt actief mee over de ontwikkeling van nieuwe activiteiten. Je werkt onregelmatige diensten en draagt iedere dag bij aan een veilige, gestructureerde en betekenisvolle leef- en werkomgeving.

Samen met je collega's maak je iedere dag het verschil voor bewoners die behoefte hebben aan duidelijkheid, structuur en een omgeving waarin zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen.

Wil jij bijdragen aan een betekenisvolle dag voor mensen met een intensieve ondersteuningsvraag? Een van onze collega's zet een mooie volgende stap binnen Vanboeijen. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe coördinator dagbesteding die samen met ons het verschil wil maken voor onze bewoners.

Op de locatie Geelbroekerweg in Hooghalen bied je samen met je collega's een veilige, prikkelarme omgeving aan jongvolwassenen en volwassenen met complexe zorgvragen en moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Wonen en dagbesteding zijn hier onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden. In een warme en huiselijke omgeving lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan een waardevolle, voorspelbare en betekenisvolle dag voor de bewoners.

title: Helpende plus
description:
Als helpende (plus) bij Medicalhunt stel je het leveren van hoogwaardige zorg voorop! Voor onze opdrachtgevers in de omgeving van Rotterdam zoeken wij collega's die zich elke dag opnieuw inzetten om een lach te toveren op het gezicht van je cliënten. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je oprecht plezier hebt in je werk en alles daaromheen goed geregeld is.

Wanneer je kiest voor detacheren, kun je afwisselen tussen verschillende doelgroepen of juist kiezen voor een doelgroep die perfect bij je past. Bijvoorbeeld met bewoners met dementie, cliënten die revalideren of mensen met een somatische zorgvraag. Het is natuurlijk belangrijk om een vertrouwd gezicht te zijn voor de bewoners. Daarom duurt een detachering meestal minimaal 2 tot 3 maanden, maar het kan ook een half jaar of zelfs een jaar zijn. In die tijd draai je volledig mee in het team.

Word jij hier enthousiast van en denk je dat jij de Helpende plus bent waar wij naar opzoek zijn? Dan willen we je graag leren kennen! We zoeken een collega die goed functioneert in verschillende situaties, houdt van afwisseling en een flexibele instelling heeft als het graag om diensten en reisbereidheid. Daarnaast vragen wij het volgende:

Een afgeronde opleiding Helpende of Helpende plus;
Een geldig rijbewijs B;
Het overhandigen van een VOG (Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag) is een vereiste.
We verwelkomen kandidaten van alle achtergronden en ervaringen. Heb jij juist ervaring in een andere vorm van zorg? Ook dan kunnen we bij Medicalhunt een plekje voor jou vinden. Stuur mij dan een berichtje om contact op te nemen! en we bieden je persoonlijke begeleiding en ondersteuning, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het beste doet zorgen voor anderen!

Natuurlijk is het belangrijk dat je beschikt over de juiste kwalificaties, zoals een diploma Helpende of Helpende plus. Maar wat voor ons echt telt, is jouw positieve energie en betrokkenheid. Kun jij verantwoordelijkheid dragen en heb jij hart voor de zorg?



Kies je voor een carrière bij Medicalhunt, dan kies je voor een betrokken en plezierige werkgever waar jij centraal staat. Wij verbinden jou met de meest interessante werkgevers en uitdagende banen in de zorg. Bij Medicalhunt krijg je de kans om in heel Nederland aan de slag te gaan binnen diverse zorgsectoren, waaronder ouderenzorg, gehandicaptenzorg, VVT, GGZ, ziekenhuizen, en jeugdzorg.

Wij weten als geen ander wat het betekent om in de zorg te werken. Vanaf het eerste contact staan wij volledig voor je klaar. We zorgen ervoor dat je terechtkomt op een locatie waar je je goed voelt en bieden je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, door te groeien en nieuwe dingen te leren. Samen willen we een verschil maken in de zorg, zowel voor de cliënten en patiënten als voor jou. Laten we samen het verschil maken!

title: Chauffeur autolaadkraan
description:
Op zoek naar een avontuurlijke baan? Dan is chauffeur autolaadkraan bij A12 Personeelsdiensten jouw job. Elke dag onderweg en op locatie je specialisme toepassen en natuurlijk goed verdienen.  

A12 Personeelsdiensten werkt voor een groot aantal opdrachtgevers waardoor gevarieerd werk gegarandeerd blijft. Daarnaast kom je bij A12 Personeelsdiensten in een hecht team, waar persoonlijke aandacht en collegialiteit voorop staat.

En vooral...
...werken wanneer, waar en bij wie jij wilt!

title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

title: storings- en onderhoudsmonteur
description:
Als storings- en onderhoudsmonteur is je belangrijkste taak het verhelpen van storingen en het verrichten van (preventief) onderhoud aan productie installaties en apparatuur, om productiestilstand tot een minimum te beperken.
Werkzaamheden vinden in principe plaats tussen 6:00 uur en 19:00 uur. (8 uur per dag) In sommige gevallen kan daar vanaf geweken worden.
Indien nodig wordt er ook op zaterdag gewerkt.

Bij Chateraise Europe B.V. rolt er geen gebak, maar patisserie van de band.

description:
Enige ervaring in de schoonmaak is fijn. Graag willen werken en willen werken in een klein en gezellig bedrijf vinden wij veel belangrijker.

Wij zijn een klein en gezellig bedrijf waar iedereen elkaar kent. Naast het werk besteden we ook tijd met elkaar door met enige regelmaat te lunchen of een kopje koffie te drinken. title: Facilitair medewerker
description:

...werken wanneer, waar en bij wie jij wilt!

title: Medewerker Spelbieb en Soos Assen
description:
Als Medewerker Spelbieb en Soos ben je het aanspreekpunt voor de Spelbieb en de Soos in Assen. In de Spelbieb zorg je voor het dagelijkse beheer, leen je spellen uit en adviseer je bewoners en collega's over passend spel- en activiteitenmateriaal. Ook draag je bij aan de zichtbaarheid van de Spelbieb, bijvoorbeeld via sociale media.

Bij de Soos organiseer en begeleid je activiteiten voor bewoners en beheer je de activiteitenkalender. Waar nodig betrek je vrijwilligers bij de activiteiten. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar altijd samen met bewoners, collega's, vrijwilligers en andere betrokkenen. Je denkt mee over nieuwe ideeën en de verdere ontwikkeling van de Spelbieb en Soos.

Je bent bereid een activiteit van een collega over te nemen en kunt indien nodig werkzaamheden uitvoeren voor de Spelbieb in Meppel.

Hou jij ervan als er reuring is en er iets te doen is? In de Spelbieb in Assen zorg je ervoor dat bewoners en collega's makkelijk een passend spel kunnen vinden en lenen. Je beheert de collectie en denkt mee over een passend aanbod. Daarnaast werk je bij de Soos in Assen, waar je activiteiten organiseert en begeleidt.

De functie is afwisselend: van spellen uitlenen en adviseren in de Spelbieb tot het organiseren en begeleiden van activiteiten bij de Soos. Je hebt contact met bewoners, collega's en vrijwilligers en krijgt volop ruimte om zelf ideeën aan te dragen en uit te voeren. Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Dan zoeken we jou!
