title: Fiskansvarig ICA Kvantum Malmborgs Clemenstorget i Lund
description:
Om butiken 🐟

Vill du arbeta i en citybutik med puls? Då har vi tjänsten till dig! Här finner du lokala färskvaror, delikata delikatesser och prisvärd vardagsmat. Butiken har ca 115 medarbetare och upp till 60 000 besökande kunder i veckan och en av de ICA butiker med flest kundbesök i landet!

Vi söker vi en engagerad Fiskansvarig till vårt fantastiska team på ICA Malmborgs Clemenstorget!

Om tjänsten 🐟

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för fisk, skaldjur, mat och försäljning och som brinner för att skapa en kundupplevelse utöver det vanliga. Tillsammans med ditt team arbetar du för att skapa stadens bästa fiskdisk, med hög kvalitet, inspirerande exponering och personlig service.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar den dagliga driften av fiskdisken, från mottagning av leveranser och påfyllning av varor till tillverkning av fisk& skaldjursrätter och en säljande presentation. Du arbetar löpande med inköp, nyckeltal, produktion och svinn samt följer leveransflöden och prognoser i AOB. Du ansvarar även för avdelningens egenkontroll och är delaktig i schemaplaneringen tillsammans med huvudansvarig.

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, engagerad och har ett naturligt driv i försäljningen. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team, tar initiativ och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö. Med fokus på kvalitet, kundupplevelse och lönsamhet vill du vara med och utveckla fiskdisken till en avdelning som inspirerar kunderna och får dem att vilja komma tillbaka.

Egenskaper och kvalifikationer 🐟

I rollen ansvarar du för den dagliga driften och arbetar aktivt för att utveckla avdelningen och nå butikens gemensamma mål. Du är engagerad, lösningsorienterad och trivs i ett högt tempo. Med ditt positiva ledarskap bidrar du till ett motiverat team, goda resultat och en förstklassig kundupplevelse.

Som person är du strukturerad, kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad. Du drivs av försäljning, kundnöjdhet och möjligheten att påverka verksamhetens utveckling. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet från ICA eller annan dagligvaruhandel, restaurangbranschen eller liknande. Du har tidigare kunskap i AOB, Min Butik eller liknande system. Erfarenhet från manuell fiskdisk är meriterande.

Vi söker dig som 🐟

Har ett genuint intresse för fisk, skaldjur och delikatesser. Du är affärsmässig, resultatinriktad och strukturerad, med ett naturligt ledarskap som inspirerar och utvecklar människor omkring dig. Du är driven, engagerad och initiativrik, vågar tänka nytt och bidrar gärna med idéer. Du trivs i en fartfylld miljö, värdesätter samarbete och har ett öga för detaljer och en känsla för säljande exponering.

Tjänsten är på heltid, varannan lördag

Provanställning

title: Vi söker behöriga förskollärare till flera av våra enheter
description:
Beskrivning

Vi söker nu ett flertal förskollärare till våra kommunala förskolor! Tjänsterna har placering på förskolorna Galaxen, Tallåsen, Ämbarbo samt Järvsö.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som förskollärare har du en ledande roll där du planerar arbetet, genomför uppföljningar samt analyserar för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med arbetslaget. Du ska arbeta aktivt för att skapa en stimulerande och utvecklande miljö där barnen står i centrum.

Tillsammans med dina kollegor ansvarar du för att verksamheten utmanar barnen till aktivitet, lärande och ansvarstagande, helt enligt läroplanens intentioner. Du har förmåga att arbeta såväl enskilt som i grupp och har intresse för att arbeta med alla åldersgrupper. Du har goda It-kunskaper, kan dokumentera och vi ser gärna att du har kunskap i pedagogisk dokumentation.

Kvalifikationer

Du har förskollärarexamen alternativt lärarexamen med behörighet att undervisa i förskolan samt förskollärarlegitimation. Vi söker medarbetare som sätter barn och föräldrar i fokus, har god kommunikationsförmåga samt upprätthåller en god service. B-körkort är ett krav.

Meriterande är om du har grundläggande datakunskaper samt att du är väl förtrogen med styrdokumenten och har förmåga att omsätta dem i praktiken.

Villkor

    Omfattning: Heltid (100 %)
    Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning
    Löneform: Månadslön
    Tillträde: 261101 eller enligt ö.k
    Antal lediga befattningar: 4

Övrig information

Beroende på tjänstens innehåll kan lämplighetsprövning, utdrag ur belastningsregistret och/eller misstankeregistret eller säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen krävas innan anställning. Anställning kan endast ske om prövningar har godkänts. Intervjuer sker löpande. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas vid prövobehov.

Övrigt:

I Ljusdals kommun tror vi att det finns ett liv för alla. Ljusdals kommun är belägen i den nordvästra delen av det vackra Hälsingland. De största orterna i kommunen är Ljusdal, Järvsö och Färila. Vi har nära till fritiden, till varandra och till en enkel vardag. Redan bosatta, hemvändare och många som tagit steget och flyttat till vår kommun vittnar om livskvalitet, mer tid att njuta och vara den du är. I Ljusdals kommun har 1700 medarbetare Sveriges viktigaste jobb när vi servar våra 19 000 invånare.  Är du den som vill berika oss med dina kunskaper, ditt engagemang och din personlighet?

Beroende på tjänstens innehåll kan lämplighetsprövning, utdrag ur belastningsregistret och/eller misstankeregistret eller säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen krävas innan anställning. Syftet är att säkerställa att anställningen kan genomföras på ett tryggt och säkert sätt utifrån verksamhetens krav. Anställning kan endast ske om prövningar har godkänts.

title: Process Engineer - Substrates
description:
As a Process Engineer in the Innovation Development Center, you will be the technical contact for prototyping activities related to Snus and Nicotine Pouch innovation projects. You will act as a domain expert by designing experimental plans, leading the prototype production lifecycle, and developing or adapting equipment to support new or complex manufacturing needs. You will collaborate closely with R&D, Quality, EHS, Manufacturing, and technicians to ensure robust, safe, and right-first-time prototyping execution.

Beyond project delivery, you will build process knowledge by translating experimental findings into technical understanding, identifying key process drivers, and continuously improving prototyping processes and equipment performance.

You will support scale-up and industrialization by assessing process transferability across equipment, defining operating principles, and partnering with manufacturing teams on trials and production campaigns to implement new products and processes successfully.



YOUR ‘DAY TO DAY’

    Act as SME to design experimental plans and identify optimal processing approaches for specific substrates and formulations, working hand-in-hand with technicians, R&D, and manufacturing teams.
    Lead the full prototype production lifecycle, from early feasibility discussions to on-floor execution, ensuring appropriate documentation including batch records, trial protocols, risk assessments, and technical reporting.
    Generate process knowledge by analyzing experimental outcomes, identifying critical process parameters, and translating findings into technical recommendations and standard methodologies.
    Support industrial trials and production campaigns, collaborating closely with manufacturing teams to assess process robustness, capture findings, and facilitate successful scale-up of new products and processes.
    Develop custom setups, adapt existing equipment, or coordinate the sourcing of additional machinery to support new activities or enable complex prototypes.
    Analyze equipment and process performance through data analysis, troubleshooting, root cause investigations, and KPI monitoring to drive continuous improvement of prototyping lines.
    Collaborate with EHS to ensure full compliance with equipment and processes, supporting risk evaluations and maintaining the highest operational safety standards.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Substrates

    Master of Science in Chemical Engineering, Food Engineering or equivalent.
    5+ years of relevant experience in process development, manufacturing, pilot-scale operations, or industrial scale-up.
    Demonstrated expertise in granulation processes, including process development, optimization, troubleshooting, scale-up, and technology transfer activities. Hands-on experience with powder handling, mixing, and related particulate processing technologies.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently lead technical investigations, troubleshoot complex process issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
    Proficient in Swedish and English.

title: Manager Innovation
description:

title: Strategy & Business Development Lead to Alleima
description:
Would you like to help shape Alleima’s strategic direction and turn business opportunities into meaningful results?

At Alleima our mission is much more than delivering high value-added products, advanced technology, and processes – working together to develop solutions based on our customers’ needs, and, thereby, achieving our business goals is a better description of our daily work.

Alleima has a clear growth ambition with set targets to strengthen our market position and accelerate businesses’ development in interesting fast-growing industry segments. With curious co-workers and safety as our first priority, we create a work environment where you can grow both personally and professionally.

About the role

As Strategy & Business Development Lead, you will help shape Alleima’s corporate strategy and contribute to long-term business growth and value creation. By exploring market trends, customer needs, competitive landscapes and emerging opportunities, you will translate insights into strategic recommendations and actionable initiatives.

Working closely with our divisions and senior leaders, you will support strategic planning and decision-making while leading complex, cross-functional projects that turn strategic priorities into tangible results.

You will also support the preparation and communication of strategic insights and plans for Group Executive Management and the Board of Directors, helping ensure alignment with Alleima’s strategic objectives.

Location for this position is Stockholm or Sandviken. If you’re based in Stockholm traveling to Sandviken and, at times, international travel is a natural part of the role.

Your key responsibilities

    Drive and contribute to the development of Alleima’s corporate strategy.
    Advance continuous business improvement, with a focus on strategy, commercial and operational excellence, and value creation.
    Provide strategic analysis and support to the CEO, Group Executive Management and the Board of Directors.
    Advise leadership teams on strategic planning and initiatives, from initial ideas through execution.
    Lead development projects and facilitate workshops.
    Strengthen business intelligence capabilities by developing insights on markets, competitors, technology and macroeconomic trends.
    Build and maintain cross-functional and international relationships to share ideas, experience and expertise.
    Lead or contribute to M&A projects.

About you

You bring experience in strategy, business development or management consulting, preferably from an industrial or international business environment, together with a university degree in finance, engineering, business administration or a related field.

Your background includes leading strategic projects, conducting market and business analyses, and identifying opportunities that contribute to business growth and long-term value creation. You are comfortable working with complex information, developing structured strategies and translating insights into practical recommendations and actions.

To succeed in this role, you combine analytical thinking with business understanding, curiosity and a solution-oriented mindset. You take initiative, challenge perspectives constructively and enjoy turning ideas into meaningful results. With a collaborative and consultative approach, you build trust, engage stakeholders and create alignment across functions and geographies.

You communicate complex topics clearly and confidently, adapting your message to different audiences, including senior management and the Board of Directors. As we operate in a global environment, you are comfortable communicating in English, both verbally and in writing.

Experience from M&A-related activities, such as market assessments, due diligence or integration, is considered an advantage.

If you enjoy connecting strategic thinking with business opportunities and believe that collaboration and different perspectives contribute to better results, this could be the right next step for you.

What you can expect from us

At Alleima, you will be part of a global organization where collaboration, curiosity and continuous development are at the heart of what we do. We believe that diverse perspectives and an inclusive workplace help us make better decisions, create new opportunities and grow together.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to Alleima's strategic direction, work closely with colleagues and leaders across our business, and turn ideas and insights into meaningful results. You will be part of an environment where your expertise, initiative and perspectives are valued, and where we work together to create long-term value for our customers and our business.

Our values guide us in everything we do: We Care, We Deliver and We Evolve. Together, we take responsibility, challenge ourselves to improve and support each other in making a difference.

title: Customer Delivery Manager
description:
Do you want to combine project management, customer ownership, team leadership, and long-term relationship building in a role with significant responsibility and variety?

IMI Supply Chain Solutions helps companies optimize and future-proof their supply chains through flexible software solutions for warehouse management, order management, transportation, inventory planning, and logistics visibility. By combining specialized solutions into an integrated supply chain suite, IMI enables greater efficiency, transparency, and scalability across complex logistics operations.

We work in close partnership with our customers to drive efficiency and innovation. We are now looking for a Customer Delivery Manager who wants to take ownership of customer relationships, service delivery, and long-term customer success.

About the Role

As a Customer Delivery Manager, you will play a key role in leading managed services engagements and IT projects from planning through delivery. You will have overall responsibility for all deliveries to your customers, including projects of varying complexity as well as ongoing service management activities and routines.

As the primary point of contact for your customers, you will play a key role in ensuring successful deliveries, strong partnerships, and long-term business value.

The role involves close collaboration with both customers and internal teams. You will lead customer and stakeholder dialogues, plan and coordinate resources, and ensure that deliveries are completed according to agreed objectives, requirements, and timelines. You will also be responsible for budget follow-up, forecasting, risk management, and change management to ensure successful deliveries and long-term value creation for our customers.

We build long-term partnerships and work closely with our clients, giving you exposure to a wide range of stakeholders, from system users to executive leadership teams. You will be responsible for translating customer needs, agreements, and changes into clear activities and deliverables. You will also contribute to pre-sales activities by supporting the preparation of proposals, documentation, and material for contract discussions and commercial opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

    Lead and manage projects from planning through delivery and follow-up
    Lead and drive managed service engagements
    Plan and coordinate internal resources based on project and business requirements
    Act as a trusted advisor to customers and external stakeholders
    Ensure deliveries meet agreed objectives, requirements, and expectations
    Monitor project budgets, costs, forecasts, and invoicing
    Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes
    Maintain project documentation and administration
    Facilitate steering committees, status meetings, and project meetings
    Contribute to pre-sales activities, proposal development, and contract discussions

Your Profile

We believe you are a collaborative and relationship-oriented professional who combines structure and business acumen with a genuine commitment to customers and colleagues. You are self-driven, organised, and accountable, and you enjoy taking ownership of both customer relationships and delivery outcomes.

You thrive in a leadership role, have the ability to bring people together around common goals, and can drive progress even in complex environments. You are a strong communicator, work independently, and build trust with both customers and internal teams.

title: Communication Advisor
description:
Join Nordregio – A Leading Nordic Research Institute

Nordregio is currently seeking to expand its communications team with a full-time position to spearhead the dissemination of Nordic research. By joining us, you'll be promoting the Nordic Vision for sustainable development, tackling vital topics like the green transition and digital inclusion. This is your chance to make a real impact in shaping the future of the Nordic region!

Main responsibilities

    Acting as a communications advisor to researchers across a portfolio of projects, developing communication strategies and plans, supporting outreach activities, and helping maximise the visibility and impact of research results.
    Editorial work incl. news articles, opinion pieces, newsletters, and invitations.
    Hosting webinars and workshops – digital and physical events.
    Visual content development – basic photo/video editing, and graphic design for social media.

Requirements 

    The position requires a bachelor’s in communications, journalism, or a social science degree.
    Communication Advisors are expected to have at least five years of relevant experience in communications, such as strategic communications, editorial work, website and social media management.
    Good command of Office, web publishing systems, and other digital communications tools.
    Strong analytical skills and the ability to take a creative approach to complex problems.
    Highly motivated with the ability to work independently, as well as the skills to work effectively in a cooperative research environment.
    Well-developed communication skills including the ability to network and work collaboratively with a range of stakeholders and partner organisations.
    Ability and willingness to contribute to Nordregio’s commitment to fostering a supportive and equitable workplace.

The applicant must be fluent in English as well as a Nordic language.

What we offer

The position starts as soon as possible - or subject to agreement. Nordregio offers contracts with a maximum length of four years. Subject to further agreement, the contract can be extended for up to four additional years. If you are currently employed by the State in a Nordic country, you are entitled to a leave of absence from your present position for the duration of your employment at Nordregio according to the agreement “Avtale om rettstilling for samnordiske institusjoner og deres ansatte”. Candidates relocating from another Nordic country to Sweden are offered a relocation package as well as a monthly salary addition. For our employees to perform at a high level, we support, in various ways, the employee’s own responsibility and initiative to find a balance between work and private life. Examples of support include generous health benefits, remote work according to individual agreements, opportunities for peer-to-peer learning, and encouraging social gatherings.

Why Nordregio?

Nordregio is an international research centre for regional development and planning. We conduct solution-oriented and applied research, addressing current issues from both an academic perspective and from the viewpoint of policymakers and practitioners. Nordregio participates in European, Nordic and national research programs and carries out commissioned projects for different levels of government. We conduct case-studies in different regions, perform territorial analyses on a transnational and pan-European level, and undertake evaluations of various European and national programs.

We are a team of multidisciplinary, international people and our office is situated in attractive surroundings at Skeppsholmen in the heart of Stockholm, Sweden. The institute was established in 1997 by the Nordic Council of Ministers and is built on 50 years of Nordic collaboration.

Working at Nordregio provides you with the opportunity to become part of a truly international research environment. We offer significant career development potential in terms of enhancing your international network of contacts in both policy and academic fields, as well as an extensive experience with project management. You will also have rich opportunities to collaborate with regional and municipal stakeholders in the Nordic countries.

Application 

Application deadline: We look forward to your application, including CV and personal letter in English no later than November 5, 2026.

How to apply: Click on "ansök här" at the bottom of the page. When you are redirected to the "integritetspolicy" (privacy policy) page, check the box to accept it. On the next page regarding "offentlighetsregler" (publicity rules) click on "fortsätt" to proceed to your application.

We kindly request applicants to not submit their application via e-mail.

title: Head of Product Data Governance
description:

To support growing business volumes, Siemens Energy is establishing a Product Data Governance department within the Medium Gas Turbines Product Lifecycle (MGT PLC) organization in Sweden. As Head of Product Data Management, you will set the strategic direction for product data governance, optimize Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools and processes, and build a high-performing team. Your work will strengthen data integrity, streamline engineering workflows, and enable effective cross-functional collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. You bring extensive experience in product data management, strong leadership capabilities in a technical environment, and a proven ability to manage complex engineering data structures.

    Align product data governance initiatives with broader organizational digital transformation roadmaps and corporate standards.

    Tools, Processes & Lifecycle Management

    Lead the consolidation, optimization, and governance of product data tools, PLM systems, and associated engineering workflows to improve data quality, efficiency, and lifecycle traceability.

    Collaborate with engineering, IT, and operations to streamline data exchange, system integration, and configuration management processes.

    Establish and maintain standards for configuration control and product structure definition across relevant technical teams.

    Leadership & Capability Building

    Build, lead, and develop the newly formed Product Data Governance department, managing capacity planning and competency development.
    Promote data-driven ways of working across the Product Lifecycle organization and sister business units by establishing clear ownership, shared standards, and effective collaboration.
    Manage departmental budget, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications up to senior leadership levels.

Education

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information management, or a related technical field.
    At least eight years of experience in product data management, product lifecycle management, or data governance within a complex engineering or manufacturing environment.
    Proven track record of leadership, team building, and managing organizational change in a multinational setup.

Skills

    Data Governance & Management: Strong expertise in Product Data Management (PDM), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), data quality and integrity, configuration management, and Master Data Management (MDM).
    Leadership & Strategy: Proven ability to translate product data strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and sustainable ways of working, combined with strong capabilities in team leadership and development, strategic planning, stakeholder management, change management, and resource and capacity planning.
    Technical & Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of engineering data systems, gas turbine product structures, and process optimization, combined with excellent communication skills in Swedish and English and the ability to explain complex product data topics to both technical and senior leadership audiences.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Enterprise Architect, Business Transformation & Portfolio
description:
Shape the future technology landscape at TreTre is strengthening its architecture function to support major transformation initiatives across Sweden and Denmark.

We are modernising our technology landscape, investing in cloud, AI, digital capabilities and long-term architecture to support future growth.

As part of this journey, we're looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect, Business Transformation & Portfolio who wants to help shape the future of one of the Nordic region's leading telecom operators.

You will connect business strategy, technology direction and investment decisions, helping Tre make better choices about what to standardise, modernise, consolidate, buy, build or retire.

This is not an architecture approval role. Your purpose is to create clarity, make complex choices visible and help the organisation make better decisions earlier.

About our architecture communityAt Tre, architecture is evolving into a stronger advisory capability with greater influence across business and technology.

Our architects help create clarity, guide strategic decisions and connect long-term direction with practical execution. As our Enterprise Architect, you will work closely with Domain Architects, Technology Architects, engineering teams and senior leaders to shape the future technology landscape across Sweden and Denmark.

This is an opportunity to join a growing architecture community with increasing impact on technology strategy, transformation initiatives and business outcomes.

About the roleAs our Enterprise Architect, Business Transformation & Portfolio, you will help define Tre's long-term technology direction and ensure that strategic business goals translate into sustainable architecture decisions.

You will work across business domains, technology platforms and transformation initiatives, connecting business capabilities, systems and investments into a coherent enterprise landscape.

Working closely with business and technology leaders, Domain Architects, Technology Architects and portfolio stakeholders, you will help shape target architectures, strategic roadmaps and key investment decisions while establishing Tre's Enterprise Architecture capability.

Your focus extends beyond individual programmes. You will help drive portfolio coherence, simplification and long-term technology direction across Sweden and Denmark.

What you'll do

In this role, you will:

    Define and evolve the enterprise target architecture across Sweden and Denmark.
    Connect business capabilities, strategic objectives, applications, platforms and investment decisions.
    Drive portfolio-level decisions regarding standardisation, modernisation, sourcing and legacy retirement.
    Identify cross-domain dependencies, risks and decisions that require enterprise-wide alignment.
    Establish architecture direction for major transformation initiatives.
    Support leadership with recommendations and decision material for strategic business and technology investments.
    Develop enterprise roadmaps, transition plans, architecture principles and decision records.

You can look forward to:

    A central role in shaping the future technology landscape of a leading Nordic telecom operator.
    The opportunity to influence strategic investment, platform and transformation decisions.
    Working across Sweden and Denmark within a federated architecture model.
    Close collaboration with business leaders, architects and engineering teams.
    Major transformation initiatives involving customer experience, telecom platforms, cloud, AI and modern software delivery.
    Joining a growing architecture function with increasing influence on strategic business and technology decisions.

Mats describes himself as a leader:"I believe great architects create clarity rather than complexity. We provide advisory and 'marriage counseling' for IT and Business. I value curiosity, accountability and collaboration, and I encourage people to challenge established ways of working when there is a better path forward. My role as a leader is to provide direction, remove obstacles and create an environment where people can have real impact and grow in their area of expertise."

We believe you have

Must-have:

    Experience as an Enterprise Architect or in a comparable senior architecture role.
    Experience working across business strategy, technology strategy and complex transformation portfolios.
    Experience developing enterprise target states, roadmaps and transition architectures.
    Experience with application portfolio management, sourcing decisions and legacy-modernisation strategies.
    The ability to analyse complex dependencies and turn them into clear decision options.
    Experience influencing senior stakeholders without relying on formal line authority.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice-to-have:

    Telecom, digital-service-provider or subscription-business experience.
    Experience with TM Forum frameworks, including ODA.
    Experience coordinating architecture across multiple countries.
    Knowledge of BSS/OSS transformation, cloud platforms or data architecture.
    TOGAF or another relevant architecture qualification.

We're looking for someone who:

    Thinks strategically while remaining pragmatic.
    Creates clarity in complex environments.
    Builds strong relationships across business and technology.
    Is comfortable challenging established assumptions in a constructive way.
    Communicates complex topics in a way that enables decisions.
    Is curious, proactive and driven by continuous improvement.

You value collaboration, accountability and evidence over architecture for architecture's sake. You help organisations make better decisions rather than creating unnecessary complexity.

title: Tech Lead
description:
About Evora Labs

Evora Labs develops technology for the operation, integration, and management of battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

Our platform helps energy asset owners integrate assets, achieve market readiness, maintain operational availability, and manage technical requirements across energy markets and grid  services.

About the role

As Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day engineering of the Evora platform: the cloud backend, the operator frontend, the EMS edge software that runs at battery sites, and the infrastructure that connects them.

  You will work close to real assets. The code you write reads Modbus registers from live battery systems, runs prequalification tests against the Swedish TSO's technical requirements, ingests Nordic and continental market data, and dispatches setpoints that a safety envelope on the edge is the last line of defense for.

  The position combines hands-on full-stack development, system architecture, ownership of the edge and integration layer, technical leadership of a small team, and continuous translation of  field experience from live BESS projects into the product.

Key responsibilities

  - Own the architecture and technical roadmap of the Evora platform across backend, frontend, edge, and cloud infrastructure.

  - Design and build backend services in Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, asyncpg, Alembic) on top of TimescaleDB, Redis, and MQTT.

  - Develop and maintain the EMS edge software: Modbus and vendor-protocol drivers, register maps, control loops, safety envelope, and store-and-forward telemetry over AWS IoT Core.

  - Build operator-facing product in the Next.js and React frontend: fleet monitoring, asset and site management, the visual workflow builder, dashboards, and market explorers.

  - Own the prequalification engine that drives FCR-N, FCR-D, FFR, aFRR, and mFRR test programs, validates the response against TSO technical requirements, and produces the evidence and

    application values.

  - Integrate battery management systems, power conversion systems, meters, inverters, EV chargers, and heat pumps through Modbus, vendor cloud APIs, and gateway hardware.

  - Build and operate the market-data pipelines (ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, Nord Pool style sources) that feed spot, ancillary, and forecast views.

  - Extend the platform's agent layer: LLM-driven operations assistants, morning briefings, diagnosis and remediation workflows, and the AI workflow builder, using Claude on AWS Bedrock.

  - Run the AWS infrastructure with Terraform: EC2, IoT Core, ECR, S3, IAM, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships backend images and the Vercel-hosted frontend.

  - Keep the full-system test suite (app, broker, edge, database) green and extend it as the control loop grows.

  - Support commissioning of live BESS sites together with the operations and prequalification team, and investigate communication, control-system, and data issues in the field.

  - Set engineering standards for code review, testing, migrations, observability, and documentation, and grow the team as Evora scales.

  - Contribute technical expertise in customer discovery, partner integrations, and pre-sales discussions.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built and operated production software end to end and who is comfortable going from a battery's register map to a React component in the same day.

  You should have:

  - University degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, automation, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  - Several years of professional experience building and operating backend systems in Python, preferably with FastAPI or a similar async framework.

  - Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, and experience with time-series data at scale (TimescaleDB, continuous aggregates, compression, partitioning).

  - Experience building modern web frontends with TypeScript and React, preferably Next.js.

  - Experience with industrial or IoT communication: Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, or comparable protocols, and with software that runs on edge devices or gateways.

  - Experience running software on AWS or a comparable cloud, including infrastructure as code (Terraform), containers, and CI/CD.

  - Ability to read technical documentation, device specifications, and grid or market requirements, and turn them into working, tested software.

  - Experience leading technical work: setting architecture, reviewing code, and mentoring engineers.

  Meritorious experience

  It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:

  - Battery energy storage systems, EMS, BMS, PCS, meters, or other distributed energy resources.

  - Nordic ancillary-service markets and prequalification for FCR, aFRR, mFRR, or FFR.

  - Electricity-market data sources such as ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, or Nord Pool.

  - LLM-based applications, tool-calling agents, or AI-assisted operational tooling.

  - Workflow or orchestration engines (Temporal or similar) and event-driven architectures.

  - Federated learning or privacy-preserving analytics on distributed data.

  - Edge hardware, balena or similar fleet management, and cellular gateways.

  - Full-system or hardware-in-the-loop testing of control systems.

Personal profile

You are technically hands-on and enjoy owning a system from the field device up to the user interface.

You work systematically, write code that others can read and test, and are comfortable investigating problems that span hardware, communications, databases, and user-facing product.

What we offer

  You will join Evora Labs at an early stage and take a central role in shaping how distributed energy assets are integrated, qualified, and operated through software.

  The position provides the opportunity to work across the whole stack, from Modbus registers on a battery site to market participation and AI-assisted operations, and to set the technical direction of a growing engineering team.

  The role is based in Stockholm.

title: Geophysicist within exploration
description:
Combine geophysical analysis with hands-on fieldwork and contribute to mineral exploration in a varied role with excellent opportunities to grow.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

As a Geophysicist within our Mineral Exploration team, you will bridge the gap between advanced data processing and practical field operations. Your responsibilities naturally follow the seasons—dedicating summer periods to dynamic fieldwork and ground data acquisition and focusing during the winter months on comprehensive data processing, 3D modelling, interpretation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Data Processing & Interpretation: Process, model, and interpret multidisciplinary geophysical data to delineate targets and refine geological models.
    Field Acquisition: Lead and participate in hands-on geophysical surveys and data collection campaigns across active exploration sites.
    Exploration Strategy: Provide critical geophysical insight to optimize drilling programs and advance mineral exploration initiatives.
    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with exploration geologists and specialists across LKAB, including geotechnics and mining operations.
    Project Participation: Engage flexibly in a wide variety of project stages as organizational needs and strategic exploration priorities evolve.

You will work both independently and together with others. Close collaboration with fellow geophysicists, geologists and field technicians is essential for success in this role, as exploration projects rely on combining different areas of expertise and perspectives. The varied assignments and opportunities to participate in different projects provide excellent potential to develop within your professional field.

What you bring

We are looking for a geophysicist who thrives in a dynamic environment where fieldwork, data interpretation and collaboration go hand in hand. You have a structured and solution-oriented way of working, communicate your findings clearly and can translate complex data into valuable insights. You enjoy working closely with colleagues from different disciplines and contribute to a collaborative team environment. You are reflective and thoughtful in your decision-making, with an ability to balance technical opportunities with responsible use of resources to create sustainable and effective exploration solutions.

We are looking for someone who has:

    Education: Higher university degree in geophysics. Strong background in physics.
    Experience in mineral exploration: Candidates with several years of relevant experience in mineral exploration will be given preference. However, all applications will be considered and reviewed based on the overall qualifications and experience of the candidate.
    Good spoken and written english
    Valid B driving licence for manual transmission vehicles

It is an advantadge if you have:

    Geophysical Software:Proficiency in industry-standard software packages such as Oasis montaj (Seequent), Mira Geoscience, Leapfrog Geo, Maxwell, ModelVision,GeoTools.
    Electromagnetic Methods: Practical and theoretical experience with EM methods, with particular emphasis on Magnetotellurics (MT / AMT).
    Proficiency in Swedish, or a genuine willingness to learn.

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden:

    Relocation support for you and your family.
    Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
    LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
    The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

title: Construction & Facilities Manager (12-Month Parental Cover)
description:
We’re looking for a Construction & Facilities Manager to plan, coordinate, and manage how Axel Arigato physical spaces are built, refurbished, and maintained - from stores to showrooms and pop-ups. Do you like seeing a project through from first plan to opening day, on time and on budget? You’ll own the budget for these spaces, working closely with contractors, landlords and teams across the business to keep each one safe, functional and well maintained. It’s a year of growth: three new US projects are live, and European expansion into the UK is underway. Come join us.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role suits someone who stays calm under pressure and is organized by default. You plan carefully, follow through, and keep contractors, landlords and colleagues aligned when timelines get tight. You’re comfortable managing external partners across several markets, you hold suppliers to a clear standard, and you look for ways to make each project run smoother than the last.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

    

Own time schedules, RACI, budgets, labor and risk mitigation plans for every construction and refurbishment project.

    

Lead projects from start to close-out, coordinating subcontractors and keeping landlords, contractors and internal stakeholders updated on progress.

    

Review, adapt and execute lease, supplier and maintenance agreements through a transparent procurement process that reduces business risk.

    

Run snag, punch and QC reports and follow up on execution, so every store opens to standard.

    

Manage preventive and corrective maintenance with our facilities partners in the US and EU, tracking both performance and cost.

    

Bring commercial design feedback into each project to keep store quality and customer experience consistent.

    

Set and follow up department goals each quarter, making responsibilities clear and ensuring tools and resources to deliver.

    

Partner with other departments to share knowledge and improve how we work together.

ARE YOU THE ONE?

We seek people with most of the following:

    

A background in building and construction, through PMP or similar training in construction or facilities management, or 5+ years of experience in retail construction or facilities management.

    

Experience leading a team or working in a similar role.

    

A solid understanding of construction and maintenance requirements for commercial spaces.

    

Experience managing external service providers across multiple markets.

    

Strong time management and clear, confident verbal communication.

    

A problem-solving mindset and the initiative to act on it.

    

Familiarity with lean and/or agile ways of working.

    

Confidence in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, with AutoCAD, SketchUp or Asana as a plus.

HERE’S HOW TO APPLY

If you want to shape how our physical spaces are built and cared for, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply by submitting your CV in English. Please do not include a photo or date of birth with your application; our recruitment process is competency-based.

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

CONTRACT TYPE & START DATE

Estimated starting date: January 2027. Contract type: Fixed-term contract for 12 months, covering parental leave. Full-time. Location: Gothenburg, Sweden. On-site at our central office.

A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATO

Founded in Sweden in 2014 by Albin Johansson and Max Svärdh, Axel Arigato was born with a disruptive mindset, modernising and democratising the sneaker landscape through a blend of style, quality, community and a digital-first approach.

Grounded in Scandinavian minimalism and elevated with playful, intentional details, every piece is designed with care: crafted to move globally, worn with individuality.

What began online expanded into physical spaces built for energetic cultural exchange: stores and experiences where conversations, performances and unexpected activations dissolve the boundaries between brand and culture.

Today, Axel Arigato continues to evolve with purpose via a people-powered approach. It shows up where culture happens: on streets, at events and across cities.

Built on curiosity. Driven by connection.

OUR VALUES

DROP: Diversity, Respect, Openness and Passion are our core values. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

title: Cyber Defence Manager

Required Experience & Skills

We are looking for someone with:

    Strong experience leading and coordinating Security Operations / SOC environments.

    Experience leading P1, critical and major security incidents.

title: Hemstädare / Home cleaner - Hemfrid Växjö
description:

Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska.

Bland annat erbjuder vi:

    Ett av Sveriges härligaste team med kollegor från hela världen. 🙌



Om Hemfrid

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör för tjänster i hemmet. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, tvätt, strykning, flytt, trädgårdsarbete och mycket mer. Genom att arbeta som ett team och ge våra kunder enkel tillgång till våra toppklassiga tjänster förbättrar vi deras livskvalitet.

Do you want a job where you make a difference every day? At Hemfrid, you get to help people in their everyday lives while developing yourself, enjoying a secure employment, and becoming part of a wonderful team 🌟

We are looking for new home cleaners to join our team in Växjö!

Your profile

We love making our customers’ everyday lives easier – and so should you. We are looking for someone who likes to work independently and is driven by quality and customer service. You are punctual and responsible, with an eye for details and a positive attitude.

About the role

As a home cleaner at Hemfrid, you are responsible for cleaning our customers’ homes to the highest quality. Your mission is always to provide the best service possible. You work independently and are responsible for your clients’ satisfaction.

Your work tasks include, among others:

We offer

Among others, we offer:

About Hemfrid

Hemfrid is Sweden's leading provider of home services. We help our customers with cleaning, laundry, ironing, moving, gardening, and more. By working as a team and providing easy access to first-class home services, we unlock people's quality of life.

Our process

After completing the application, you will be contacted by the HR department regarding the recruitment process for your application.

As part of our recruitment process, we always do a background check. You need to have a Swedish personal number or a coordination number to be eligible for this position.

Are you ready to unlock people's quality of life? Great! So are we. We look forward to your application.

Welcome to Hemfrid!

title: Process Equipment Engineer - Furnace
description:
As part of building our Maintenance Engineering organization, we are expanding our team with a Process Equipment Engineer focused on our Furnace Area. This is an opportunity to contribute to a technically advanced manufacturing environment and play an important part in strengthening our capabilities within the Furnace Area.

Read more about Silex here.

The team and the area

You will be part of the Maintenance Engineering organization and report to the Maintenance Manager. The Teams purpose is to provide technical leadership for assigned equipment and work closely with Team Managers, Service Technicians, Maintenance Engineers, Process Engineers, Area Managers, and external suppliers.

The Furnace Area is an important part of our production and includes advanced high-temperature processes such as epitaxy, Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD), and thermal oxidation. These processes are used to grow and deposit controlled material layers and to form high-quality oxide films, making stable temperature profiles, gas flows, pressure, and equipment conditions essential to product quality and process repeatability. You will bridge equipment maintenance and process engineering, using equipment data, process results, and production feedback to identify causes of instability, improve uptime and utilization, and ensure that technical actions are coordinated across teams.

About the role

As a Process Equipment Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical health, reliability, and continuous improvement of equipment within the Furnace Area. Equipment is your primary discipline, supported by process knowledge that enables effective fault analysis, improvement work, and close collaboration with Process Engineers.

You will act as the technical lead for the assigned equipment, guide service technicians, coordinate technical escalations, and lead root cause analyses of downtime events and recurring failures. You will also develop equipment monitoring and preventive maintenance, define relevant KPIs, contribute to equipment purchases and upgrades, and serve as a technical contact for suppliers.

In this role, you will:

    

Act as the technical lead for assigned furnace equipment, guiding service technicians and leading complex troubleshooting, root cause analyses, and follow-up of corrective actions.

    

Manage technical escalation plans and coordinate equipment status, priorities, and actions with Team Managers, Process Engineers, and suppliers.

    

Use equipment and process data to identify causes of instability, define and follow up KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, and MTTR, and improve equipment monitoring through equipment dashboard and SPC.

    

Develop preventive maintenance routines, maintain technical documentation, and contribute to equipment purchases, installations, upgrades, and spare-part planning.

    

Lead equipment-related risk analyses and ensure LOTO and other safety requirements are reflected in maintenance routines, documentation, and training.

We are looking for someone who has:

    

A Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

    

At least five years of relevant experience in manufacturing with strong equipment-related knowledge and an understanding of production processes. Experience in semiconductor or MEMS process development or manufacturing is an advantage.

    

Experience with root cause analysis, data analysis, SPC, quality-control methods, equipment monitoring, and preventive maintenance systems.

    

Proficiency in English, particularly in technical terminology and documentation. Swedish is considered as highly meritorious.

To thrive in this role, you enjoy working analytically and finding practical solutions to complex technical challenges. You take a structured and proactive approach to your work, communicate clearly with different stakeholders, and are comfortable guiding others. With several activities often running in parallel, you are also able to prioritize effectively and ensure that actions are documented and followed through.

What we offer you

    

The opportunity to work with cutting-edge MEMS technology and some of the most advanced equipment in the industry.

    

A technically challenging environment where you solve complex problems and continuously develop your expertise.

    

A varied role in which new challenges, technologies, and improvement opportunities make every day different.

About Silex

Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.

The recruitment process

We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.

Application

title: Arbetsledare Verkstad till Epiroc i Slagsta
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vi utökar vår verkstadsverksamhet i Slagsta med en nyckelroll och söker dig som vill kombinera teknisk förståelse med ett engagerande och närvarande ledarskap. Om du trivs med att leda det dagliga arbetet, skapa struktur och få människor att utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans kan detta vara rollen för dig.



Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du.



Bli en del av vårt teamI Slagsta ansvarar vi för service och underhåll av Epirocs maskiner och utrustning åt våra kunder. Du blir en viktig del av en verksamhet där säkerhet, kvalitet och samarbete står i fokus. Teamet består av cirka 8-10 tekniker med hög teknisk kompetens, och din roll blir att skapa förutsättningar för att arbetet flyter effektivt samtidigt som du bidrar till en positiv och motiverande arbetsmiljö.







Ditt uppdragSom arbetsledare i vår största verkstad i Sverige har du en central roll i den dagliga verksamheten. Du ansvarar för att planera, prioritera och följa upp arbetet i verkstaden samt säkerställa att teamet har rätt förutsättningar att leverera hög kvalitet till våra kunder.Rollen har inget formellt personalansvar, men du fungerar som den operativa ledaren för verkstadsteamet och är en viktig länk mellan teknikerna och verksamhetens mål. Du är närvarande i det dagliga arbetet, fångar upp behov, coachar medarbetare och säkerställer att arbetsflöden och processer fungerar på bästa sätt. Samtidigt har du löpande kontakt med befintliga kunder kring planering, offerter och serviceuppdrag.







Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:•    Planera, leda och fördela det dagliga arbetet i verkstaden.•    Coacha och stötta tekniker i deras dagliga arbete.•    Följa upp att arbetet genomförs enligt plan, kvalitet och säkerhetskrav.•    Vara kontaktperson för befintliga kunder och hantera servicerelaterade frågor.•    Kalkylera och offerera servicearbeten samt reparationer.•    Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra till effektivare arbetssätt.•    Bidra till en positiv, engagerande och inkluderande teamkultur.







Din profil



Vi söker dig som tycker om att leda människor och som motiveras av att få både verksamhet och individer att utvecklas. Du är en positiv och initiativtagande person som trivs med att ta ansvar, kommunicera tydligt och skapa engagemang i gruppen. Du har förmågan att bygga förtroende, fånga upp behov och skapa struktur även när tempot är högt.







För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:•    Erfarenhet av att leda, samordna eller arbetsleda medarbetare i en operativ verksamhet.•    Teknisk bakgrund från verkstad, service, industri, entreprenadmaskiner, fordon eller liknande område.•    Förmåga att planera och koordinera arbetsflöden samt följa upp resultat.•    God kommunikativ förmåga och flytande svenska i tal och skrift.•    Grundläggande datorvana.



Tidigare erfarenhet av Epirocs produkter är meriterande men inte ett krav. För oss är ledarskapsförmåga, teknisk förståelse och förmågan att få människor att lyckas tillsammans viktigare än specifik produktkunskap.







Placering och resorTjänsten är placerad i Slagsta, Stockholm. Resor kan förekomma vid behov.







LedarskapsförväntningarPå Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar.







Ansökan och kontaktinformationVill du vara med och utveckla vår verkstadsverksamhet i Slagsta tillsammans med ett kompetent och engagerat team? Skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt men senaste 2026-11-02Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.Anställande chef, Andreas Arvidsson, andreas.arvidsson@epiroc.comRekryteringsspecialist, Tekla Brunetto, tekla.brunetto@external.epiroc.com

title: CO₂ Regulation Specialist - Powertrain Technology
description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:Your Future Team  

The Certification & Compliance (C&C) Department at Powertrain Technology is a global team of approximately 40 professionals based in Sweden, France, the USA, Brazil, and India. Our mission is to manage powertrain certification and compliance activities, ensuring that our products meet applicable regulatory requirements for power, emissions, CO₂, energy efficiency, fuel consumption, OBD, EMC, and electrical safety. We make sure our products remain compliant throughout their lifecycle, helping Volvo sell its products, reduce the risk of non-compliance, and contribute to safer products and a better environment.



We work with components and systems across the driveline for both battery-electric vehicles and internal-combustion-engine vehicles, as well as future powertrain technologies.  

  

Certification & Compliance Sweden is a team of 12 experienced engineers with backgrounds in areas such as engine development, verification, certification, and regulatory compliance. We are a friendly and supportive team, and an excellent sounding board for certification and regulatory questions.

  

We are now looking for a CO₂ Regulation Specialist to join us.

  

What You Will Do

  

As a CO₂ Regulation Specialist, you will safeguarde that Volvo’s products remain compliant with applicable regulations over time. You will support Volvo’s mission, “Driving prosperity through transport and infrastructure solutions,” by ensuring that the company honors the intention of the law while developing safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible products.

  

You will act as the certification and compliance expert in EU CO₂ emissions and fuel-consumption regulations and be an active member of the Powertrain Interpretation Forum. You will interpret regulations, define and document regulatory requirements for driveline components and systems, covering both battery-electric and internal-combustion-engine vehicles, as well as future powertrain technologies.  

  

An important part of the role will be communicating new and changing regulatory requirements across the Powertrain organization. You will maintain regulatory guidance documents, ensure that they remain accurate and up to date, and provide training to help colleagues understand and apply the requirements in their daily work.

  

You will work closely with colleagues across Powertrain and Volvo Group, including the Vehicle CO₂ Regulation Specialist and the Product Regulation Development Specialist, to ensure that CO₂ data and related processes are compliant. The role will also involve regular contact with type-approval authorities and other external stakeholders to align on the interpretation and application of regulatory requirements.

Profile description:

Who are you?

  

You are a technical professional with a genuine interest in compliance, technology, and the automotive industry. You are motivated by combining curiosity, analytical thinking, and attention to detail to develop products and ways of working that meet both current and future regulatory requirements.

title: PRODUKTIONSTEKNIKER - LÖVSTJÄRNAN FABRIKS AB
description:
Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB (LöFAB) is a Swedish defence manufacturing company established to support Nordic and NATO security-of-supply requirements through manufacturing, co-production, and lifecycle sustainment through partnerships and sub-contracts with global OEMs. LöFAB provides an EU-based industrial solution that enables compliant production, long-term support, and scalable capacity within Europe.

Trivs du i en roll där du kombinerar teknik, struktur och verksamhetsutveckling samtidigt som du får stort eget ansvar?

Vill du vara med och skapa effektiva, robusta och framtidssäkra produktionsprocesser som bidrar till företagets fortsatta utveckling? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB är ett företag i stark utveckling där kvalitet, innovation och långsiktigt tänkande är viktiga delar av verksamheten. För att möta framtidens krav och fortsätta vår tillväxt söker vi nu en Produktionstekniker som vill ta en nyckelroll i att utveckla, säkra och effektivisera våra produktionsprocesser.

Om rollen

Som Produktionstekniker - med fokus på Beredning - har du en central roll i verksamheten med ansvar för att säkerställa att alla förutsättningar finns på plats för en effektiv, säker och kvalitetssäkrad produktion. Rollen omfattar produktionsberedning, industrialisering och utveckling av produktionsprocesser med målet att skapa stabila flöden, hög leveranssäkerhet och korta ledtider.

Du arbetar nära konstruktion, produktion, kvalitet, inköp och logistik för att säkerställa att produkter, material, dokumentation, verktyg och resurser är redo innan produktionen startar. En viktig del av uppdraget är att omsätta konstruktionsunderlag till effektiva tillverkningsprocesser samt att säkerställa att förändringar implementeras på ett strukturerat och kontrollerat sätt.

I rollen ansvarar du även för produktionsunderlag, arbetsinstruktioner, stycklistor, operationsberedningar och processdokumentation. Du deltar i arbetet med prototyper, pilotserier, processvalidering, riskanalyser och förbättringsprojekt som stärker verksamhetens produktionsförmåga.

Du blir en nyckelperson i arbetet med att skapa robusta processer, minska produktionsrisker och utveckla förutsättningarna för en effektiv och framtidssäkrad tillverkning.

Du är

Du har en teknisk utbildning inom maskinteknik, produktionsteknik, industriell teknik eller motsvarande och har erfarenhet av produktionsberedning, industrialisering, produktionsteknik eller tillverkningsutveckling inom tillverkande industri.

Du har god förståelse för tillverkningsprocesser och är van att arbeta med teknisk dokumentation, arbetsinstruktioner, affärssystem och produktionsrelaterade processer. Erfarenhet av Monitor ERP är meriterande, liksom erfarenhet från försvarsindustri, flygindustri eller annan reglerad verksamhet.

Du har en stark analytisk förmåga och trivs med att skapa struktur i komplexa miljöer. Samtidigt är du pragmatisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att driva frågor framåt och omsätta idéer till fungerande arbetssätt.

Som person är du noggrann, ansvarstagande och prestigelös. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner och bygger goda relationer samtidigt som du tar eget ansvar för att skapa resultat som gör skillnad för verksamheten.

Du får

En attraktiv tjänst i ett växande industriföretag där du får stort inflytande över utvecklingen av företagets produktionsprocesser och tillverkningsförmåga. Du blir en del av en entreprenöriell verksamhet med korta beslutsvägar, högt engagemang och goda möjligheter att påverka.

Här får du chansen att ta en central roll i arbetet med att stärka verksamhetens kvalitet, leveransförmåga och konkurrenskraft samtidigt som du utvecklas tillsammans med företaget.

Ansökan

Vill du vara med och utveckla Lövstjärnan Fabriks produktionsförmåga och skapa effektiva, robusta och framtidssäkrade produktionsprocesser för framtiden? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig. Urval sker löpande.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs en säkerhetsprövning. För att kunna erbjudas anställning krävs en godkänd säkerhetsprövning.

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB med FSK Group.

Om FSK

Vi är FSK, The Generator – ett bolag som driver utveckling och tillväxt genom våra tre affärsområden:

Talent – Vi hjälper framåtlutade företag att hitta rätt människor, främst inom Management, Specialists, Sales och Marketing.

Brand – Vi stärker varumärken genom Employer Branding och Business Branding.

Growth – Vi skapar inspirerande och utmanande utbildningar som utvecklar företag för framtiden.

Nu ligger den betydligt närmare den disposition och ton du brukar använda i dina annonser.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developers in Goteborg design, build and improve web applications that support real business workflows, including practical AI-enabled features. You own features across frontend, backend and data layers, from requirements clarification through production delivery. Working onsite with product owners, architects, designers and client stakeholders, you combine hands-on engineering with precise specifications, responsible use of AI development tools and validation of business outcomes. This role matters because it drives the creation of robust, user-focused solutions that enhance enterprise operations.

Responsibilities

    Understand how users work, clarify requirements with product owners and domain experts, and surface assumptions, dependencies and constraints before implementation
    Translate agreed requirements into buildable feature specifications and testable acceptance criteria, covering business rules, data flows, permissions, edge cases and failure scenarios
    Design, implement and maintain frontend components, backend services, REST APIs and data models within the agreed architecture; explain technical trade-offs and raise decisions that affect other systems
    Use AI coding assistants and agents to support implementation, testing and refactoring. Provide clear context and constraints, review generated changes and remain accountable for their correctness, security and maintainability
    Integrate applications with enterprise systems and AI services through APIs, supporting features such as summarization or semantic search with appropriate authentication, data consistency, output validation and fallback behavior
    Write automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests. Demonstrate features against agreed business scenarios, incorporate user feedback and make validation gaps visible
    Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation; support releases, application monitoring and production troubleshooting
    Diagnose issues across the stack using logs, traces and test evidence, distinguishing requirement gaps from implementation defects and test failures
    Improve existing codebases through focused refactoring, peer reviews and documentation; communicate delivery risks and propose practical improvements within the agreed scope

Requirements

    Five years in software development, with frontend and backend experience and independent delivery of production features
    Strong proficiency in at least one backend stack, such as C#/.NET, Node.js or Python, with sound knowledge of API design and application architecture
    Solid JavaScript/TypeScript skills and practical experience with React, Angular or a comparable framework, including responsive, accessible interfaces and application state management
    Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, schema changes, query performance and data consistency trade-offs
    Practical experience with cloud-hosted applications, preferably Azure, and working knowledge of containerization, CI/CD and infrastructure as code
    Strong automated testing, debugging, Git and code review skills, with experience addressing application security, reliability and performance
    Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents, including supplying requirements and repository context, checking generated code, diagnosing failures and following project data-handling rules
    Practical exposure to integrating LLM APIs through a project or prototype, with a basic understanding of prompts, output validation, data privacy and usage costs
    Ability to clarify business workflows and turn them into implementable requirements and acceptance scenarios, including behavior inferred from existing applications
    Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders; willingness to ask questions, challenge unsupported assumptions and escalate risks early
    Ownership of feature quality through implementation, deployment and user feedback, with effective collaboration across product and engineering

Nice to have

    Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or managed cloud AI services, particularly on Azure
    Experience with identity and access management, event-driven integrations or enterprise application modernization
    Deeper experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or application observability
    Experience in automotive or other enterprise environments, and participation in client workshops or user acceptance sessions

We offer/Benefits

    EPAM Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
    Company’s pension plan
    Private healthcare insurance
    Safety & life insurance
    Gym discounts
    Wellness Grant (SEK 2000)
    Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards
    Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses

*All benefits and perks are subject to certain eligibility requirements

title: Head of Editorial
description:
Head of Editorial

About TOTEME

TOTEME is a fashion house rooted in Swedish sensibilities, modern aspirations, and the notion of style.

With an appreciation for how pieces are worn in practice, we create emblematic designs with an emphasis on materiality and shape. Archetype pieces are realized in authentic materials, rich textures and graphic silhouettes. Representing a direct and decisive way of dressing, the collections are contextualized in curated edits, visuals, and spaces.

TOTEME was founded in 2014 by Elin Kling and Karl Lindman. From the atelier in Stockholm, we create women’s and men’s collections spanning ready-to-wear, shoes, bags, accessories, and jewelry.

The Role

TOTEME is looking for a Head of Editorial to join our team in Stockholm on a full-timebasis. In this role, you will define and lead TOTEME’s global editorial direction, shaping the brand’s voice and narratives across women’s and men’s collections, markets and customer touchpoints. You will report to the Chief Marketing Officer and work directly with the Creative, Brand and Communications Teams.

Responsibilities

    Define and evolve TOTEME’s global editorial direction, tone of voice and messaging principles.
    Develop seasonal narratives, collection briefs and notes, and oversee the seasonal editorial calendar.
    Lead editorial concepts and messaging for campaigns, launches, collaborations, events and key brand initiatives.
    Own editorial storytelling and copy for seasonal newsletters and organic Instagram, and develop new storytelling formats.
    Write and shape brand statements, press releases, corporate messaging and communications for senior leadership.
    Lead naming for key products and develop product stories that connect to wider seasonal and brand narratives.
    Establish messaging frameworks that guide consistent communication across teams, regional markets and retail education.
    Provide editorial direction to the Lead Copywriter, setting priorities and workflows and reviewing key communications.
    Participate in and contribute to TOTEME’s social and environmental sustainability strategy.

Your Profile

    Extensive experience in editorial leadership, copywriting or brand communications within fashion, luxury or a similarly brand-led environment.
    Proven ability to develop distinctive brand narratives, campaign concepts and messaging frameworks across channels and markets.
    A sophisticated understanding of fashion, design, culture and luxury positioning.
    Experience guiding writers and collaborating with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
    Fluent in spoken and written English, with exceptional writing and editing skills.

About You

    A TOTEME ambassador who shares our culture and values.
    Strong creative judgment and a considered approach to storytelling.
    A strategic mindset that connects brand expression with business priorities.
    Highly organized, balancing long-term editorial direction with ongoing business needs.
    A confident, collaborative communicator who provides clear direction and builds alignment across teams.

This is a full-time  position based at TOTEME’s Stockholm Office, starting in January 2027.

TOTEME has teams in Stockholm, London, New York, and Shanghai, as well as retail spaces across Europe, North America, and Asia.

TOTEME has an internal career development and title framework and the job title used in the recruitment ad may differ from the title used internally at TOTEME.

Candidates progress through application, screening, interviews or case assessments, followed by final pre-employment checks and a formal offer before joining our team. We anonymize names and personal details in applications during the screening stage to support fair and skills-based hiring.

By applying to this position, I agree with TOTEME’s privacy policy and to be contacted about future job opportunities for up to two years from the submission date. Find out more about our privacy policy here.

title: Senior research engineer to Robotics and AI
description:

You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics & AI Group at Luleå University of Technology is seeking a motivated Senior Research Engineer with a focus on software and hardware development for autonomous robots.





The Robotics & AI Group is involved in numerous field-oriented projects, requiring a versatile and proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment.





Project description



You will join an excellent team and collaborate with a diverse group of people working in the field of Robotics and AI.





Duties

    Develop and optimize software for robotic systems using Python and C++.
